ELNFOR.title: APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC 7% Senior Secured Notes due 15-Jun-2031
ELNFOR.headline: APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC's $1.59bn 7.00% senior secured notes due June 2031 fund the third 150 MW building (ELN-04) at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota, leased to CoreWeave. The building is still under construction, so the credit combines construction and delivery risk (backstopped by a parent completion guarantee), single-tenant CoreWeave exposure with a possible upgrade path through an unconsummated June-2026 MoU to an investment-grade CoreWeave subsidiary, and an amortization profile that leaves about 85% to refinance in 2031. Sponsor model coverage is 1.2x from 2028, and the bond traded down to about 94 by Oct 2026 amid supply-overhang concerns.

items.label: Issuer / notes title
items.text: APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC (Delaware; subsidiary of Applied Digital Corporation) - 7.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031, sold under a 9-Jun-2026 purchase agreement (Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC representative), Rule 144A / Regulation S.

items.label: Principal / issue price
items.text: $1,590mm original principal, issued at 100.000% of par. Outstanding at 31-Aug-2026: $1,590mm (no amortization yet).

items.label: Coupon and dates
items.text: 7.000% fixed, semi-annual in arrears on 15 Jun and 15 Dec, first payment 15-Dec-2026. Day count not stated in the 8-K.

items.label: Issue date / maturity
items.text: Issued 16-Jun-2026 (priced 9-Jun-2026); matures 15-Jun-2031 (about 5.0 years).

items.label: Ranking and security
items.text: Senior secured obligations of the issuer; guaranteed by its existing and future direct and indirect subsidiaries; first-priority liens on substantially all assets of the issuer and guarantors (excluded property carved out) and on all equity of the issuer held by APLD HPC Holdings 2 LLC.

items.label: Mandatory amortization
items.text: Semi-annual on 15 Jun and 15 Dec, beginning on the first payment date after the final Commencement Date under all data center leases in effect on the issue date, in indenture amounts (adjusted for redemptions or add-ons). Sponsor model (illustrative): 2.70% of original principal initial annual amortization with 0.50 pt annual escalators: $22mm (2027), $51mm (2028), $59mm (2029), $67mm (2030), $75mm (2031); debt about $1,392mm at end-2030, so roughly $1.35bn (about 85%) is due at maturity.

items.label: Optional redemption
items.text: Before 15-Jun-2028: 100% plus make-whole; up to 40% with certain equity offering proceeds at the indenture price. From 15-Jun-2028: indenture redemption prices (not in 8-K; seed first call price 103.5 = par plus half a coupon, unverified). Change-of-control put at 101%.

items.label: Trustee / collateral agent
items.text: Wilmington Trust, National Association.

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: Seed: ISIN US03790NAA54, CUSIP 03790NAA5 (144A). Not confirmed in an official document; no Reg S identifiers found.

items.label: Governing law, denominations, clearing
items.text: Not stated in the 8-K; indenture exhibit not read in full.

items.label: Borrower chain
items.text: Applied Digital Corporation -> ... -> APLD HPC Holdings 2 LLC (direct parent; the same holdco that sits above APLD ComputeCo, the APLD notes issuer) -> APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC (issuer) -> guarantors. Silos are separate: ComputeCo 3 holds only the ELN-04 project.

items.label: Subsidiary guarantors
items.text: APLD ELN-04 HoldCo LLC, APLD ELN-04 LLC and APLD ELN-04 LandCo LLC (wholly owned by the issuer per the 10-K). Applied Digital Corporation is not a guarantor of the notes. The 10-K names the lessor of the third CoreWeave lease as 'APLD ELN-02 C LLC'; whether this is the same entity as ELN-04 LLC (renamed) was not confirmed.

items.label: Ring-fencing
items.text: Indenture limits business to the Ellendale facility and certain additional projects; limits on debt, liens, restricted payments, affiliate dealings and fundamental changes; completion guarantee from the parent.

items.label: Project
items.text: ELN-04 = third physical HPC building (150 MW, 'PF1-3') at the Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale ND; the press release calls it the 'fourth building' because the lease is the fourth lease/building counting the original design.

items.label: Sponsor
items.text: Applied Digital Corporation (NASDAQ: APLD). 1,410 MW contracted, $6.4bn debt and $3.7bn cash/restricted cash at 31-Aug-2026; Polaris Forge 1 has 250 MW live (Buildings 1 and 2); Building 3 (this notes' project) is under construction.

items.label: Parent facilities
items.text: $430mm secured revolver (non-data-center-project assets, matures earlier of 29-May-2029 or 91 days before a PEPA date), $450mm 2.75% convertibles due 2030, Series G preferred line raised to $2.0bn (Jun-2026), $58.5mm Texas Capital note, and a guarantee of Base Electron's ~$2.4bn design-build contract.

items.label: Macquarie preferred
items.text: Macquarie Asset Management preferred in APLD HPC TopCo 2 LLC: about $1.8bn funded (incl. $925mm on 29-May-2026, four weeks after the ELN-04 bridge was signed), up to $5.0bn plus $4.9bn remaining right; 12.75% PIK/cash coupon, 15% of common, perpetual with company call after year 5 and investor put after year 7 or on sale, 1.8x MOIC floor. Whether any of it was applied to ELN-04 equity is not disclosed.

items.label: Equity contribution rule
items.text: Under the Macquarie unit purchase agreement Applied Digital funds equity at $750k per MW of capacity (less equity already invested), about $112mm for 150 MW; ELN-04 actual equity not disclosed.

items.label: Tenant
items.text: CoreWeave, Inc. Third Polaris Forge 1 lease ('Building 4 Lease') signed 28-Aug-2025 by APLD ELN-02 C LLC for 150 MW, bringing CoreWeave's Polaris Forge 1 contracted capacity to 400 MW. Applied Digital Corporation guarantees the lessor subsidiary's obligations to CoreWeave (landlord performance, not rent).

items.label: Contract value and term
items.text: Company: 15-year base term with three five-year renewal options; Polaris Forge 1 total about $10.7-11.0bn for 400 MW. Sponsor ELN-04 model: total 15-year revenue $4,086mm and NOI $3,683mm over a lease running to 2042, i.e. $227mm / $234mm / $241mm revenue in 2029 / 2030 / 2031 (about 3% escalator; about $1.5mm per MW per year in 2029, estimate). Seed: base rent $1.43mm/MW, 3.0% escalator (consistent with model growth).

items.label: Lease form
items.text: Company describes leases as 15-year, take-or-pay, non-cancellable gross modified leases with termination for convenience requiring payment of full remaining value. Company expects 88% (+/-3%) site NOI margin for PF1; model NOI/revenue is about 90%.

items.label: Commencement
items.text: Model assumes ELN-04 Phase 1 Commencement Date of 30-Jan-2027. 10-K/10-Q: anticipated ready for service/full capacity in calendar 2027. Seed: Jan-Jun 2027. Phased (Phase 1 only) commencement drives the first amortization date through 'final Commencement Date'.

items.label: Tenant credit migration (MoU)
items.text: On 5-Jun-2026 Applied Digital and CoreWeave signed a memorandum of understanding to assign the lease for 'Building 3' at Polaris Forge 1 (the ELN-04 building) to a CoreWeave subsidiary if that subsidiary achieves an investment-grade credit rating. News coverage of a JPMorgan note says the bank's Overweight on ELNFOR rests on this MoU and that it depends on CoreWeave financing its GPUs; no such rating event has been reported.

items.label: Contrast with ELN-02/03
items.text: The 30-Mar-2026 CoreWeave restructuring (assignment of ELN-03 and two ELN-02 halls to CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. VIII, LLC with springing parent guaranty and a $50mm LC) is disclosed only for ELN-02/03. For ELN-04 the tenant of record disclosed in the 10-K is CoreWeave itself; no third-party credit support is disclosed.

items.label: Delay / termination / SLA / assignment terms
items.text: Not publicly disclosed. 10-K risk factor: lessees may have termination rights for significant construction delays. Guarantee refers to Outside Completion Date under the lease (extendable).

items.label: Tenant-side disclosure
items.text: CoreWeave's Q2-2026 10-Q does not name Applied Digital or the Ellendale leases; no tenant corroboration found.

items.label: Location and campus
items.text: Ellendale, North Dakota; Polaris Forge 1 (400 MW: Building 1 100 MW pilot, Buildings 2 and 3 at 150 MW each). ELN-04 is the third building (150 MW).

items.label: Design
items.text: Standard Applied Digital AI Factory: ~907,500 sq ft, six data halls, hybrid liquid and air cooling, N+1 substation, diesel backup, 625 W/sq ft, 1.15 target PUE; 12-18 month build target per 150 MW (company reference spec).

items.label: Cost per MW
items.text: Company anticipates $11-13mm per MW. Seed: facility cost $1.92bn / $12.8mm per MW, 74% debt-funded (unverified; within range).

items.label: What the notes finance
items.text: (i) Construction of 150 MW critical IT at ELN-04; (ii) repayment of the $300mm Goldman Sachs Bank USA bridge; (iii) debt service reserve; (iv) expenses.

items.label: Power supply
items.text: Polaris Forge 1 is grid-connected in Ellendale; serving utility and interconnection agreement are not named in the filings reviewed. Company says use of excess regional grid capacity has returned more than $45mm of electricity credits to local ratepayers, and that each contracted MW is backed by land and/or an executed utility power agreement.

items.label: Campus power status
items.text: Buildings 1 and 2 (250 MW) are already energised and operating at full load, which is evidence the campus interconnection supports at least 250 MW; Building 3 energisation date not disclosed.

items.label: Status at 16-Oct-2026
items.text: Building 3 (ELN-04, 150 MW) under construction; company guidance is ready for service in calendar 2027 (10-K and 10-Q). No ELN-04 ready-for-service reported. Photos in the June-2026 deck show the building in construction.

items.label: Schedule precedent
items.text: Same campus delivered Building 2 in two 75 MW phases on 1-Jul-2026 and 1-Oct-2026, roughly on the model's date (30-Jun-2026 assumption) for ELN-03; Building 1 operational Oct 2025.

items.label: Completion guarantee
items.text: Applied Digital must fund the issuer as necessary to ensure completion of the Construction Period and, as applicable under the lease, the occurrence of the Phase 1 Commencement Date before the Outside Completion Date (as extended); applies if note proceeds and available funds including prior parent equity are insufficient.

items.label: Contractor / contract type
items.text: EPC contractor, GMP or fixed-price terms and construction cost to complete are not disclosed in the filings reviewed.

items.label: Funding of build before notes
items.text: $300mm Goldman Sachs Bank USA bridge facility (credit agreement 1-May-2026; Daily SOFR +2.75%; guaranteed by ComputeCo 3 subsidiaries and by Applied Digital Corporation; secured on ComputeCo 3 assets) outstanding at 31-May-2026 and repaid from the notes.

items.label: Sources and uses
items.text: Not published as a table. Model assumptions: notes $1,590mm; capitalized interest $129mm over the construction/ramp period; DSRA of $81mm (the DSRA line total); exact equity not shown.

items.label: Leverage and coverage (model)
items.text: NOI of $199mm (2028) / $205mm (2029) versus $1,590mm notes = about 8.0x / 7.8x (estimate; seed 8.2x). Model DSCR 0.99x in 2027 (partial year), 1.19x 2028, 1.20x 2029, 1.21x 2030, 1.23x 2031 and rising to 1.72x by 2041, using an illustrative 7.5% coupon versus the actual 7.00% (modestly better actual coverage).

items.label: Maturity / refinancing
items.text: Roughly $1.35bn (about 85%) due 15-Jun-2031 with about 10.5 years of lease term left (model). No excess-cash-flow offer shown in the model, unlike the earlier ComputeCo notes.

items.label: Market value
items.text: 10-Q (level 2) fair value about $1.5bn at 31-Aug-2026 versus $1.59bn principal (about 94 on rounded numbers). A news summary of the post-JPMorgan sell-off reports the bond around 94.5 for a yield of about 8.44%, from the 99 area in early Aug (third-party, unverified). Seed: 15-Sep yield 8.19%, spread 338 bp.

items.label: Parent
items.text: Completion guarantee only; no parent guarantee of the notes or of rent.

items.label: Reserves
items.text: Debt service reserve funded from proceeds; $81mm in model; capitalized interest of $129mm in model.

items.label: Tenant
items.text: No third-party residual-value guarantee or credit support disclosed; CoreWeave Inc. is tenant of record for ELN-04 per 10-K; possible assignment to an investment-grade CoreWeave subsidiary under the Jun-2026 MoU.

items.label: Termination protection
items.text: Company states leases are take-or-pay and non-cancellable with full remaining value payable on termination for convenience.

items.label: Covenants
items.text: Limits on additional debt and guarantees, restricted payments, investments, liens, asset sales, sale-leasebacks, unrelated business, affiliate transactions and mergers; 101% CoC put; customary events of default.

items.label: Waterfall / tests
items.text: Cash waterfall, lock-up and DSCR distribution tests not disclosed in sources reviewed (indenture not read in full).

items.label: S&P / Fitch / Moody's
items.text: Seed: NR (Moody's) / BB- (S&P) / BB- (Fitch). No agency release accessible; unverified.

items.label: Stated uses
items.text: Fund construction of 150 MW (ELN-04) at Polaris Forge 1; repay the Goldman Sachs Bank USA bridge facility; fund debt service reserves; pay transaction expenses.

items.label: Construction not started producing rent
items.text: Whole 150 MW is pre-delivery; rent starts only after Phase 1 commencement (model 30-Jan-2027). Delay risk is backstopped only by a parent completion guarantee from a company with $6.4bn debt and heavy capex.

items.label: Tenant credit
items.text: Single tenant, CoreWeave; the MoU upgrade path depends on CoreWeave SPV obtaining an investment-grade rating and has not occurred.

items.label: Balloon
items.text: About 85% of principal due at maturity in June 2031.

items.label: Supply overhang
items.text: Sponsor intends to finance Polaris Forge 3, Delta Forge 1 and Delta Forge 2 next (JPM estimate about $7.8bn debt) which pressures sector spreads.

items.label: Price sensitivity
items.text: Fell from par at issue to about 94 within four months.

items.label: Issuance and bridge repayment
items.text: Closed 16-Jun-2026; $300mm bridge repaid.

items.label: Construction
items.text: As of 7-Oct-2026 Building 3 under construction, ready for service targeted in calendar 2027.

items.label: Market
items.text: JPMorgan cut APLD/PFORGE project bonds to Neutral (about 12-Oct-2026) but kept ELNFOR Overweight (news summary); bond reportedly fell to about 94.5.

items.label: Delta Forge financing and Investor Day
items.text: No filing, press release or rating report found for a Delta Forge financing marketed in Sept 2026, nor for an Aug-2026 Investor Day, as of 16-Oct-2026. Meta is not named by the company as a tenant; it appears only in JPMorgan commentary relayed by news. The relevance for ELNFOR is parent funding capacity and spread read-across.

CoreWeave restructures ELN-02 and ELN-03 leases into an SPV (not ELN-04).

News reports ELNFOR around 94.5 / 8.44% yield after the sell-off.

CIFR.title: Cipher Compute LLC 7.125% Senior Secured Notes due 15-Nov-2030
CIFR.headline: Project-finance notes of Cipher Compute LLC ($1.733bn outstanding) that fund the 207 MW critical IT Barber Lake data center in Colorado City, Texas, leased to Fluidstack with a Google backstop equal to the debt and a Cipher completion guarantee. Credit hinges on on-time delivery (now Q4 2026-Q1 2027 after change orders), Google's backstop, and the parent's ability to fund a cost increase of roughly $0.5bn while its equity has been hit by a heavy 2032 convertible and 2030 exchange. The notes amortize but leave a large balloon at Nov-2030.

items.label: Issuer
items.text: Cipher Compute LLC, a wholly owned indirect subsidiary of Cipher Digital Inc. (then Cipher Mining Inc.). Direct parent: Cipher Songbird LLC. Subsidiary guarantor: Cipher Barber Lake LLC.

items.label: Notes title and format
items.text: 7.125% Senior Secured Notes due 2030, sold under Rule 144A and Regulation S; same series as the Nov-2025 add-on notes.

items.label: Coupon
items.text: 7.125% per year, paid semiannually in arrears on 15 May and 15 November, first payment 15-May-2026. Day-count convention not stated in the 8-K.

items.label: Issue dates and price
items.text: $1,400mm issued 13-Nov-2025 at 100%. Add-on of $333mm closed 24-Nov-2025 at 100.250% plus accrued interest from 13-Nov-2025, identical terms other than issue date and price.

items.label: Principal
items.text: Original $1,400mm plus $333mm = $1,733mm. Outstanding at 30-Jun-2026: $1,733mm, of which $94.5mm is classified as due within one year (carrying value net of costs $1,614mm).

items.label: Ranking and security
items.text: Senior secured, first-priority liens on substantially all assets of the issuer and Cipher Barber Lake (excluding certain property), all equity of the issuer held by Cipher Songbird, a Fluidstack lockbox account if and when established, and, until completion of the initial construction phase, a Google pledge of its warrants to purchase Cipher shares. Notes are guaranteed by Cipher Barber Lake.

items.label: Optional redemption
items.text: Before 15-Nov-2027: make-whole at Treasury plus 50bp, and up to 40% may be redeemed with equity proceeds at 107.125%. On or after 15-Nov-2027: 103.563% (to Nov-2028), 101.781% (to Nov-2029), par thereafter.

items.label: Mandatory amortization
items.text: Semiannual on 15 May and 15 Nov per a payment schedule in Article 14 of the indenture (daily amortization amounts accrue from the Commencement Date); no amortization before completion of the Barber Lake facility. The 24-Nov-2025 supplemental indenture changed the amortization amounts and DSRA requirement. Per the company, amortization tracks the Google backstop, which is set by Fluidstack rent payments.

items.label: Excess cash flow offer
items.text: On or before each 15 May and 15 Nov the issuer may be required to offer to buy back notes at par with 50% of Excess Cash Flow.

items.label: Termination-fee mandatory redemption
items.text: Upon receipt of the datacenter lease termination fee under the Lease Recognition Agreement and the Google financial support agreement, 100% of the proceeds must redeem notes at par plus accrued interest.

items.label: Change of control
items.text: Offer to repurchase at 101% of principal plus accrued interest.

items.label: Trustee, collateral agent, law
items.text: Wilmington Trust, National Association as trustee and collateral agent; New York law; minimum denominations $2,000 and $1,000 multiples; DTC book-entry.

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: Seed lists ISIN US17253NAA54 and CUSIP 17253NAA5 (144A). The indenture text retrieved does not state the identifiers, so they are not verified here.

items.label: Chain
items.text: Cipher Digital Inc. (parent, listed) -> Cipher Songbird LLC (direct parent of issuer) -> Cipher Compute LLC (issuer) -> Cipher Barber Lake LLC (guarantor, owns the facility and is landlord under the Fluidstack lease). The tenant-side recognition agreements sit at Cipher Barber Lake level.

items.label: Ring-fencing
items.text: Indenture covenants restrict the issuer and guarantor from holding assets or conducting operations unrelated to the Barber Lake facility, from incurring additional debt, making restricted payments, creating liens, doing sale-leasebacks and affiliate transactions, and from merging.

items.label: Obligor and guarantors
items.text: Issuer Cipher Compute LLC; subsidiary guarantee from Cipher Barber Lake LLC. Parent Cipher Digital Inc. is not a guarantor of the notes; it provides a completion guarantee only (see credit support).

items.label: Equity contribution
items.text: Company presentation (Oct 2026) shows the project capitalized with $710mm of parent equity and the $1,733mm bond, i.e. about $2,443mm of sources (derived, equals the seed facility-cost figure).

items.label: Parent
items.text: Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR; filed as Cipher Mining Inc. until early 2026) is a developer/owner/operator of industrial-scale data centers. Its 10-Q describes one operating bitcoin site (Odessa, TX, 207 MW, fixed-price PPA) plus HPC builds for Fluidstack/Google (Barber Lake), Amazon (Black Pearl and Stingray) and six further sites expected to be built out for HPC.

items.label: Parent liquidity at 30-Jun-2026
items.text: Unrestricted cash $831.8mm; restricted cash $3.73bn (project-level, from the three secured note deals); total debt principal $6,016mm (two convertibles $1.47bn, three project notes $4.54bn); company-stated net debt $1,456mm; stockholders' equity $562mm. Q2 2026 revenue $25mm, adjusted EBITDA -$30mm, net loss $267.5mm incl. a $150.5mm warrant fair-value loss. H1 2026 operating cash flow -$152mm and capex $964mm.

items.label: Parent revolver
items.text: $200mm revolving credit facility dated 23-Mar-2026 (Morgan Stanley Senior Funding agent), 4-year tenor with springing maturity 91 days before the 1.75% 2030 convertible maturity if any remain outstanding; borrowing capped at $50mm until first HPC cash flows; first lien on substantially all assets of the parent and guarantors. Minimum liquidity covenant $100mm / $150mm / $200mm stepping up as Barber Lake and Black Pearl commence cash flow; borrowing requires market cap of at least $3.0bn. No drawings and $33.1mm of letters of credit at 30-Jun-2026.

items.label: Parent convertibles (context only)
items.text: 1.75% convertible due May-2030 ($172.5mm, conversion price about $4.45); 0.00% convertible due Oct-2031 ($1.3bn, conversion price about $16.03); new 0.00% convertible due 1-Nov-2032 ($850mm base plus $150mm option, conversion price about $15.31, priced 14-Oct-2026, settlement scheduled 16-Oct-2026). These are senior unsecured parent obligations, structurally subordinated to the project notes at the asset level and not obligations of the issuer SPVs.

items.label: Tenant
items.text: Fluidstack USA II Inc. (Fluidstack), a private AI cloud platform. Lease entered 24-Sep-2025, amended and restated 20-Nov-2025, amended again 24-Sep-2026. Fluidstack financial statements are not public (see gaps).

items.label: Capacity
items.text: Original 168 MW critical IT (max 244 MW gross); A&R lease added 39 MW critical IT (56 MW gross) in a second phase: 207 MW critical IT, 300 MW gross. Fluidstack leases the whole 300 MW at the site.

items.label: Lease type and term
items.text: Modified gross with annual escalators. Rent starts on the commencement date of each phase; the 10-year term runs from Phase I commencement, with two five-year extension options. Company guidance at signing: site NOI margin 85-90% and project cost about $9-10mm per MW of critical IT.

items.label: Rent per MW
items.text: Company illustrative schedule shows rent revenue of about $333mm in the first full year (2027) rising roughly 3% a year, i.e. about $1.6mm per critical IT MW (derived). Contract value about $3.8bn over 10 years; about $9bn if both 5-year extensions are exercised (Nov-2025 statement).

items.label: Year 11-20 commitment
items.text: On 24-Sep-2026 Cipher signed a binding commitment with an unnamed 'leading AI lab' for a separate 10-year lease starting after the Fluidstack term, on substantially consistent economics, about $5.2bn of incremental revenue; company states total contracted revenue at Barber Lake is now $9.1bn over 20 years. Whether this new lease carries any Google or other credit support is not disclosed.

items.label: Delay and rent credits
items.text: Lease delivery is phased by data hall; company reports no rent credits incurred to date (as of Oct 2026). Specific delay/termination rights of Fluidstack are in the lease, which was not reviewed (exhibit omitted schedules).

items.label: Revised delivery schedule (Sep-2026 amendment)
items.text: Tenant-modification change orders agreed; data halls now expected to be delivered between Q4 2026 and Q1 2027, rent commencing per hall, first rent in Q4 2026. Before the amendment, Phase I was expected by Sep-2026 and Phase II by Jan-2027.

items.label: Amended rent commencement by data hall
Cost-sharing
items.text: Cipher bears the first $359.3mm of costs above the initial budget; tenant reimburses 50% of costs above that threshold over the 20-year term as additional rent, calculated to give Cipher a contracted return on the reimbursed amount.

items.label: Location
items.text: Barber Lake, near Colorado City, Texas. Site described at signing as 587 acres of surrounding land and potential for a 500 MW expansion.

items.label: Capacity
items.text: 207 MW critical IT, up to 300 MW gross, five data halls per the delivery table.

items.label: Cost (company estimates)
items.text: Original budget about $2,157mm; company estimate-at-completion as of 6-Oct-2026 about $2,941-2,966mm (range read from presentation chart text); cost per MW of critical IT therefore about $10.4mm original versus about $14.2-14.3mm now (derived). Nov-2025 guidance had been $9-10mm per MW.

items.label: What the notes finance
items.text: A portion of Barber Lake construction (initial $1.4bn) and of the additional facilities / phase II ($333mm add-on).

items.label: Grid supply
items.text: Barber Lake is described as having currently energized capacity; the 25-Sep-2025 release cites energized capacity plus 500 MW of expansion potential. The specific utility, interconnection agreement and any ERCOT approvals for Barber Lake were not found in the documents reviewed.

items.label: ERCOT Batch Zero (pipeline context)
items.text: News reports that ERCOT issued conditional Batch Zero classifications on 15-Sep-2026 for 3.2 GW of Cipher pipeline: 1.1 GW conditional base load (Stingray 100 MW, Colchis 1,000 MW) and 2.1 GW conditional studied load (Mikeska 500, Apollo 900, Stingray Phase II 200, McLennan 500 MW); 1.4 GW at Mikeska and Apollo is subject to partial-capacity-load curtailment risk; an ERCOT audit in Dec-2026 sets final designations. Barber Lake itself is not listed. These are pipeline sites and do not directly affect the CIFR notes.

items.label: Behind-the-meter gas (context)
items.text: Oct-2026 presentation: about 2.5 GW of behind-the-meter potential, investment in lateral pipelines at multiple sites, and Barber Lake 'developing lateral pipelines capable of delivering natural gas to various sites'. No gas supply contract or BTM plant is part of the noteholder collateral.

items.label: Status
items.text: Q2 2026 (4-Aug): 100% equipment secured, tenant had commenced beneficial use including partial occupancy and compute deployment, initial rent expected Oct-2026 (original plan). Oct-2026 deck (data as of 30-Sep): construction on track for amended milestones, equipment fully secured, tenant deploying compute throughout the facility, initial rent commencement approaching.

items.label: Delivery vs rent
items.text: Rent commences per data hall as delivered; first rent expected Q4 2026 and all five halls by Q1 2027. As of 16-Oct-2026 no filing confirms first rent has started.

items.label: Contractor
items.text: Not identified in the documents reviewed for Barber Lake (see gaps).

items.label: Overrun protection
items.text: Parent completion guarantee: Cipher will fund the issuer as needed to complete the facility (including the additional facilities) if note proceeds and other funds are insufficient. Tenant cost-sharing framework above $359.3mm (50%).

items.label: Debt
items.text: $1,733mm 7.125% senior secured notes; seed shows about 70% debt-funded, consistent with $1,733mm over about $2,443mm of sources (derived 71%).

items.label: Reserves
items.text: Debt service reserve required amount on issue date $210mm (two interest payments plus third interest and first amortization); during construction minimum $110mm plus next two interest payments (as of the original indenture, before the add-on supplemental changes).

items.label: Funding gap and new equity
items.text: Company estimate-at-completion (about $2.94-2.97bn) is above identified sources (about $2.44bn: $710mm parent equity plus $1,733mm notes). The company states additional parent project equity of about $750mm supports the lease extension and rentalized costs (pro forma project capitalization 45% equity / 55% debt) and that 2032 convertible proceeds will fund the additional Barber Lake equity investment.

items.label: Amortization and balloon (company illustration)
items.text: Illustrative schedule: mandatory amortization about $38mm in 2026, $152mm 2027, $157mm 2028, $162mm 2029, $166mm 2030, ending balance about $1,058mm at end-2030 before any ECF uptake, i.e. a balloon of roughly 60% of principal at the Nov-2030 maturity (read from garbled chart text; verify against the deck). Seed estimates amortization at 44%.

items.label: Leverage
items.text: Seed shows 6.1x at issuance and 3.0x at maturity; not verified.

items.label: Google backstop
items.text: Google LLC backstops Fluidstack obligations under the lease in an amount that rose from $1.4bn to $1.733bn (equal to the notes). Effective from the lease commencement date. On a Fluidstack payment default or insolvency, if no replacement tenant is agreed within a set period, Google may (i) pay rent and assume the lease, (ii) pay a termination fee and receive an equity interest in Cipher Barber Lake, or (iii) defer the election while paying rent. The termination fee was increased in the Nov-2025 A&R recognition agreement after Phase I delivery.

items.label: Backstop amortization
items.text: Company illustration shows the backstop amortizing in step with the debt and a 'Google lease backstop coverage ratio' trending from about 2.4x toward 1.0x by the mid-2030s (read from chart text).

items.label: Google warrants
items.text: Google received warrants over 24,178,576 Cipher shares at $0.01 per share (about 5.4% pro forma stake at signing). Top-up: if the value of the warrant shares on the business day before the exercise period starts is below $435mm (raised from $430mm), Cipher must issue more shares and/or pay cash for the shortfall. Google pledges the warrants for the benefit of lenders until the backstop becomes effective.

items.label: Warrant exposure at current prices (estimate)
items.text: Warrant liability was $632mm at 30-Jun-2026. At the $11.34 share price of 13-Oct-2026 the 24.18mm shares are worth about $274mm, below the $435mm threshold; the shortfall would be about $161mm if measured at that price. Exercise-period start date is not disclosed, so actual top-up is unknown.

items.label: Parent completion guarantee
items.text: Cipher Digital Inc. completion guarantee (A&R 20-Nov-2025) funds the issuer to complete Barber Lake. It is a construction-period support only; no parent payment guarantee of the notes was found.

items.label: Fluidstack lockbox
items.text: Issuer must use commercially reasonable efforts to procure that, while Fluidstack is tenant, Fluidstack's downstream customer pays into a Fluidstack lockbox account pledged to the collateral agent. The downstream customer is not named.

items.label: Project accounts and waterfall
items.text: Revenue Account, Debt Service Reserve Account and Notes Proceeds Account under collateral-agent control; indenture Section 4.23 sets the waterfall.

items.label: Excess cash flow
items.text: 50% ECF offer at par semiannually (see security terms). ECF offers do not reduce scheduled Installments.

items.label: Debt, restricted payments, liens
items.text: Limits on additional debt, restricted payments, investments, liens, asset sales, sale-leasebacks, affiliate transactions, and non-project activities; change-of-control put at 101%.

items.label: Events of default
items.text: Customary, including payment default, covenant breach, cross-default and collateral invalidity; the full list including lease-related events was not extracted.

items.label: Moody's / Fitch
items.text: Company's Q2-2026 presentation shows the notes at Ba3 (Moody's) and BB- (Fitch); S&P not shown (seed: NR). The agencies' own releases were not located, so triggers and outlooks are not available here.

items.label: Initial $1.4bn
items.text: Finance a portion of Barber Lake construction cost.

items.label: $333mm add-on
items.text: Finance a portion of the cost of Phase II / additional facilities within Barber Lake.

items.label: Cost overrun and funding gap
items.text: Estimate-at-completion about $0.5bn above identified sources; the parent completion guarantee depends on parent liquidity, which in turn depends on equity-linked financing (2032 convertible) after a share-price fall.

items.label: Schedule slippage
items.text: Phase I was expected by Sep-2026; delivery is now Q4 2026-Q1 2027 after change orders. Rent credits apply if milestones are missed.

items.label: Balloon / refinancing
items.text: Roughly 60% of principal is outstanding at the Nov-2030 maturity on company illustrations, before any ECF uptake, while lease and backstop run well beyond.

items.label: Tenant and backstop reliance
items.text: Fluidstack is a private company; credit relies on the Google backstop whose amount amortizes to match debt and whose mechanics depend on notice and agreement periods.

items.label: Google warrant top-up
items.text: Possible cash or share top-up to Google if Cipher stock is low when the warrant exercise period begins.

items.label: Year 11-20 lease
items.text: The AI-lab commitment is binding but unnamed and its credit support is undisclosed; it supports project returns but not the 2030 maturity.

items.label: Lease amendment 24-Sep-2026
items.text: 20-year term, $5.2bn incremental revenue, revised halls schedule, $359.3mm first-loss and 50% reimbursement framework.

items.label: Convertible 2032 and 2030 exchange
items.text: Launched 13-Oct-2026, priced 14-Oct-2026: $850mm 0.00% due 1-Nov-2032, conversion price about $15.31 (35% premium to $11.34), put 1-Nov-2030, capped call cap $28.35 costing $89.7mm, net proceeds about $835.1mm; about $165.9mm of 1.75% 2030 notes exchanged for about 40.7mm shares. Settlement scheduled 16-Oct-2026.

items.label: Equity selloff
items.text: Shares fell about 12% on 13-Oct-2026 on the launch and exchange (dilution, hedge unwinds); news reports a further 5% fall to about $10.72 on 14-Oct. Brief said 12-Oct; evidence points to 13-Oct.

items.label: ERCOT Batch Zero
items.text: Conditional classifications of 3.2 GW (see Power section); pipeline only.

BLKPRL.title: Black Pearl Compute LLC 6.125% Senior Secured Notes due 15-Feb-2031
BLKPRL.headline: $2.0bn project notes of Black Pearl Compute LLC funding the retrofit and build-out of a 300 MW gross / 216 MW critical IT campus in Wink, Texas, leased to Amazon Data Services under a 15-year triple-net sublease with an Amazon.com parent guaranty and a $9.5mm per MW tenant cost cap. First capacity was delivered two months early (Aug-2026) and rent has started, but later halls are being re-phased, the notes amortize only 7% a year leaving roughly a 70% balloon at Feb-2031, and loss of the lease or guaranty is an immediate default. Tight pricing reflects Amazon credit and tenant protections against overruns.

items.label: Parent revolver
items.text: $200mm revolving credit facility dated 23-Mar-2026 (Morgan Stanley Senior Funding agent), 4-year tenor with springing maturity 91 days before the 1.75% 2030 convertible maturity if any remain outstanding; borrowing capped at $50mm until first HPC cash flows; first lien on substantially all assets of the parent and guarantors. Minimum liquidity covenant $100mm / $150mm / $200mm stepping up as Barber Lake and Black Pearl commence cash flow; borrowing requires market cap of at least $3.0bn. No drawings and $33.1mm of letters of credit at 30-Jun-2026.

items.label: Parent convertibles (context only)
items.text: 1.75% convertible due May-2030 ($172.5mm, conversion price about $4.45); 0.00% convertible due Oct-2031 ($1.3bn, conversion price about $16.03); new 0.00% convertible due 1-Nov-2032 ($850mm base plus $150mm option, conversion price about $15.31, priced 14-Oct-2026, settlement scheduled 16-Oct-2026). These are senior unsecured parent obligations, structurally subordinated to the project notes at the asset level and not obligations of the issuer SPVs.

items.label: Tenant and parent guarantor
items.text: Amazon Data Services, Inc. (tenant); Amazon.com, Inc. (parent guarantor). Amazon.com's guaranty is called a 'limited parent guarantee' dated 21-Nov-2025 in the indenture; the company's marketing deck states Amazon.com guarantees an amount equal to all base rent and operating expenses for the life of the lease.

items.label: Lease document
items.text: Datacenter Lease is a sublease dated 28-Oct-2025 between Cipher Black Pearl LLC and the Amazon tenant; announced 3-Nov-2025 as a $5.5bn, 15-year lease with AWS.

items.label: Type and term
items.text: Triple net; 15-year base term plus three five-year tenant extension options and a short-term extension option under conditions. Tenant pays recoverable operating expenses, taxes, insurance and tenant-driven change-order costs.

items.label: Capacity
items.text: 216 MW critical IT under lease on 300 MW gross (about 75 acres).

items.label: Rent and escalator
items.text: About $5.5bn of contracted lease payments over the base term (company); 3.0% annual escalator. Company illustration: rent about $282mm in 2027 (about $1.3mm per critical MW, derived) rising to about $441mm by 2040. Seed base rent of $1.38mm per MW is not verified.

items.label: Rent commencement
items.text: Phased with rack-ready completion. Marketing deck (Feb 2026): initial rent Oct-2026, final phase Mar-2027; target rack-ready dates DH1 35 MW and NH1 15 MW on 30-Sep-2026, DH2 35 MW 31-Oct-2026, DH3 35 MW 30-Nov-2026, NH2 15 MW 31-Dec-2026, DH4 81 MW 28-Feb-2027. Superseded in part: tenant requested acceleration and first capacity was delivered in Aug-2026 with rent commenced (company).

items.label: Tenant termination rights
items.text: Casualty, condemnation, material interference, landlord sale to a restricted entity, a 120-day delivery delay with a 30-day cure, anti-bribery violation, and a grid power outage of more than 180 consecutive days (right lapses if power restored before notice). No termination for convenience after final rent commencement.

items.label: Construction cost cap
items.text: Tenant bears construction cost above a capex allowance of $9.5mm per IT MW (inclusive of the initial capex basis), provided costs are not unreasonable or caused by landlord negligence; the Amazon guaranty applies. Initial capex basis $578mm (improvements and legacy compute), reduced by up to $288mm of value Cipher recaptures from selling or repurposing existing bitcoin mining equipment; recaptured proceeds must go to the Notes Proceeds Account.

items.label: Landlord support
items.text: Cipher Mining Inc. (now Cipher Digital Inc.) is named landlord guarantor in the marketing deck; terms of that guaranty not reviewed.

items.label: Location
items.text: 11786 County Road 209, Wink, Winkler County, Texas; about 75 acres.

items.label: Facility
items.text: Phase 1: three data halls, one network hall and O&M building in 137,000 sq ft of existing buildings, retrofitted (formerly bitcoin mining; about 85% of existing infrastructure reused). Phase 2: one new data hall and a second network hall. Air and liquid cooling to the rack per the original announcement.

items.label: Cost
items.text: Tenant capex allowance $9.5mm per IT MW implies about $2.05bn for 216 MW (derived). Seed shows $2,100mm and $9.7mm per MW; not verified.

items.label: What the notes finance
items.text: Remaining Black Pearl cost, $232.5mm reimbursement of Cipher equity, debt service reserves, interest during construction and fees.

items.label: Grid supply
items.text: Grid-connected: 300 MW facility extension agreement with Oncor approved by ERCOT, interconnection at 138 kV under Oncor's transmission service tariff, N+1 substation energized, ERCOT load zone LZ_West (company marketing, Feb 2026).

items.label: ERCOT Batch Zero
items.text: Black Pearl is not among the sites reported in the 15-Sep-2026 conditional Batch Zero classifications (3.2 GW pipeline: Stingray, Colchis, Mikeska, Apollo, Stingray Phase II, McLennan); that process affects pipeline sites, not this project's existing approved interconnection.

items.label: Behind-the-meter gas
items.text: Not part of Black Pearl; the company's pipeline pitch cites about 2.5 GW of BTM potential at other sites.

items.label: Contractor
items.text: The marketing deck lists subsidiaries of Quanta Services as EPC contractor for Black Pearl; contract type (GMP/fixed price) not disclosed.

items.label: Status at 30-Sep-2026
items.text: First data center capacity delivered in Aug-2026, two months ahead of original schedule at the tenant's request, and rent has commenced; remaining Phase I halls in MEP fit-out; Phase II foundations, steel and underground electrical in progress; about 96% of equipment secured; the company says it is 'implementing updated phased delivery schedule with tenant', details not disclosed.

items.label: Overrun protection
items.text: Parent completion guarantee (notes proceeds plus prior equity); tenant bears costs above $9.5mm per IT MW allowance.

items.label: Debt
items.text: $2,000mm notes, the only project debt; no construction loan.

items.label: Reserves
items.text: Debt service reserve required: $236.0mm on the issue date (two interest payments plus third interest and first amortization); after the construction period $130.0mm (plus a proportionate amount for additional notes).

items.label: Amortization and balloon (company illustration)
items.text: 7% a year amortization from commencement: about $117mm in 2027 then $140mm a year; illustrative balance about $1.46bn at end-2030 and $1.32bn at end-2031, so roughly $1.4bn (about 70%) is due at the Feb-2031 maturity. Lease support coverage ratio shown at 2.76x rising to 3.21x. Seed estimate of 27.7% amortized is consistent.

items.label: Leverage
items.text: Seed shows 6.7x at issuance and 4.3x at maturity and 85% debt-funded; not verified.

items.label: Refinancing risk
items.text: Notes mature about 10 years before the base lease ends; refinancing a ~$1.4bn balloon relies on Amazon-backed cash flows remaining intact.

items.label: Amazon.com parent guaranty
items.text: Limited parent guarantee of the tenant's payment obligations (21-Nov-2025); marketing states it covers all base rent and operating expenses.

items.label: Parent completion guarantee
items.text: Cipher will fund the issuer as needed to complete the facility if notes proceeds and available funds (including prior equity) are insufficient.

items.label: Lease termination
items.text: Loss of the Datacenter Lease, the Real Estate Lease or the Amazon Guaranty is an Event of Default under the indenture (clause 9), with no replacement-tenant cure period in the text reviewed. Compare Stingray, which allows 6-12 months.

items.label: Residual value
items.text: No residual value guarantee or replacement-tenant backstop found; legacy bitcoin equipment recapture proceeds go to construction.

items.label: Project accounts
items.text: Revenue Account, Debt Service Reserve Account and Notes Proceeds Account under collateral-agent control; utility pass-through charges are excluded from the account requirements.

items.label: Restricted payments
items.text: After the final commencement date, distributions limited to 30% of trailing four-quarter NOI plus the excess of full budgeted construction cost over the notes issued; tax distributions need DSRA to be full; various pass-through and management-fee carve-outs.

items.label: Other covenants
items.text: Limits on debt, liens, asset sales, sale-leasebacks, affiliate transactions and modification of certain agreements; 101% change-of-control put; reports covenant.

items.label: Events of default
items.text: Payment default, covenant breach, cross-default, collateral invalidity and loss of the lease/guaranty (above).

items.label: Parent liquidity covenant
items.text: Parent revolver requires minimum liquidity of $100mm / $150mm / $200mm stepping up as Barber Lake and Black Pearl commence cash flow (parent level, not noteholder covenant).

items.label: Moody's / Fitch
items.text: Company's Q2-2026 presentation shows Ba2 (Moody's) / BB- (Fitch) for the notes; seed shows S&P NR. Agency releases not located, so outlook and triggers are unavailable.

items.label: Uses
items.text: (1) finance the remaining Black Pearl cost, (2) reimburse Cipher about $232.5mm of prior equity, (3) fund debt service reserves, (4) pay fees and expenses.

items.label: Schedule changes
items.text: Remaining halls are being re-phased with the tenant; a 120-day delivery delay gives Amazon a termination right and rent credits may apply. Schedule beyond the first hall is undisclosed.

items.label: Single-tenant concentration and lease-loss default
items.text: Lease or guaranty ceasing is an immediate Event of Default.

items.label: Guaranty scope
items.text: Indenture calls the Amazon guaranty 'limited'; its precise coverage was not reviewed.

items.label: Balloon
items.text: About 70% of principal falls due at Feb-2031 on illustrations.

items.label: Parent equity stress
items.text: Parent funds completion guarantees for three projects and has seen heavy dilution and a share-price fall around the Oct-2026 convertible; Black Pearl itself is substantially funded and phased rent is already flowing.

items.label: Retrofit risk
items.text: Phase 1 retrofits existing bitcoin-mining buildings; cost cap sits with the tenant above $9.5mm per MW, subject to reasonableness conditions.

items.label: Mar-2026
items.text: Parent signed $200mm revolver with covenants linked to Black Pearl commencing cash flow.

items.label: Aug-2026
items.text: Tenant-requested lease amendment: first capacity two months early; rent commenced.

items.label: Sep-Oct 2026
items.text: Company says remaining halls follow an updated phased schedule; parent launched and priced $850mm 2032 convertible and exchanged $165.9mm of 2030 notes; shares fell about 12% on 13-Oct.

STNGRY.title: Stingray Compute LLC 6.000% Senior Secured Notes due 15-Jun-2031
STNGRY.headline: $810mm project notes of Stingray Compute LLC financing a 70 MW critical IT / 100 MW gross data center in Andrews, Texas, leased for 15 years triple net to Amazon Data Services with an Amazon.com parent guaranty, a $10.5mm per IT MW tenant cost cap and a Cipher completion guarantee. Rent is targeted for Apr-May 2027, the substation is targeted for Q4 2026, and amortization is sized to a 1.25x DSCR leaving roughly a 70-75% balloon at Jun-2031. The tight 6.00% coupon reflects Amazon credit; risks are energization timing, a mid-stream build and parent funding capacity.

items.label: Issuer
items.text: Stingray Compute LLC, wholly owned indirect subsidiary of Cipher Digital Inc.; direct parent Cipher Stingray Holdings LLC; subsidiary guarantor Cipher Stingray LLC.

items.label: Notes title and format
items.text: 6.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031, Rule 144A / Regulation S.

items.label: Coupon
items.text: 6.000% per year, semiannual in arrears on 15 June and 15 December, first payment 15-Dec-2026. Day-count not stated in the 8-K.

items.label: Issue date and price
items.text: $810.0mm priced 8-Jun-2026 and issued 15-Jun-2026 at 99.750% (gross proceeds about $808.0mm, derived).

items.label: Principal
items.text: $810mm original and outstanding at 30-Jun-2026 (carrying value $796mm net of costs).

items.label: Ranking and security
items.text: Senior secured; first-priority liens on substantially all assets of the issuer and Cipher Stingray LLC (excluding certain property) and all issuer equity held by Cipher Stingray Holdings LLC.

items.label: Optional redemption
items.text: Before 15-Jun-2028: make-whole at Treasury plus 50bp; up to 40% from equity proceeds at 106.000%. From 15-Jun-2028: 103.000%; 2029: 101.500%; 2030 and after: par. After the Final Commencement Date, one-time par redemption of the amount needed to lift a Project DSCR below 1.10x back to 1.10x.

items.label: Mandatory amortization
items.text: Semiannual on 15 June and 15 December after the Final Commencement Date, in amounts needed to reach the Target Project DSCR, defined as 1.25 to 1.00; no amortization before completion.

items.label: Change of control and lease-termination offers
items.text: Change of control: 101% repurchase offer. The indenture also contains a 'Datacenter Lease Termination Offer to Repurchase' covenant (terms not extracted).

items.label: Trustee, law, denominations
items.text: Wilmington Trust, National Association; New York law; $2,000 minimum and $1,000 multiples.

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: Seed lists ISIN US86083AAA43 and CUSIP 86083AAA4; not stated in the indenture or 8-K, so unverified.

items.label: Chain
items.text: Cipher Digital Inc. -> Cipher Stingray Holdings LLC -> Stingray Compute LLC (issuer) -> Cipher Stingray LLC (guarantor; developer and lessor/subsidiary lessor under the Amazon lease).

items.label: Obligor and guarantors
items.text: Issuer Stingray Compute LLC; guarantee from Cipher Stingray LLC. Parent gives a completion guarantee, not a payment guarantee.

items.label: Ring-fencing
items.text: Covenants restrict additional debt, restricted payments, liens, sale-leasebacks, affiliate dealings, mergers and activities unrelated to the Stingray facility.

items.label: Equity contributed
items.text: Notes proceeds reimburse the parent for prior equity contributions of about $61.5mm per the closing 8-K; the launch release said about $63.6mm and the Q2 release said $56.7mm (unreconciled).

items.label: Parent
items.text: Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR; filed as Cipher Mining Inc. until early 2026) is a developer/owner/operator of industrial-scale data centers. Its 10-Q describes one operating bitcoin site (Odessa, TX, 207 MW, fixed-price PPA) plus HPC builds for Fluidstack/Google (Barber Lake), Amazon (Black Pearl and Stingray) and six further sites expected to be built out for HPC.

items.label: Parent liquidity at 30-Jun-2026
items.text: Unrestricted cash $831.8mm; restricted cash $3.73bn (project-level, from the three secured note deals); total debt principal $6,016mm (two convertibles $1.47bn, three project notes $4.54bn); company-stated net debt $1,456mm; stockholders' equity $562mm. Q2 2026 revenue $25mm, adjusted EBITDA -$30mm, net loss $267.5mm incl. a $150.5mm warrant fair-value loss. H1 2026 operating cash flow -$152mm and capex $964mm.

items.label: Parent revolver
items.text: $200mm revolving credit facility dated 23-Mar-2026 (Morgan Stanley Senior Funding agent), 4-year tenor with springing maturity 91 days before the 1.75% 2030 convertible maturity if any remain outstanding; borrowing capped at $50mm until first HPC cash flows; first lien on substantially all assets of the parent and guarantors. Minimum liquidity covenant $100mm / $150mm / $200mm stepping up as Barber Lake and Black Pearl commence cash flow; borrowing requires market cap of at least $3.0bn. No drawings and $33.1mm of letters of credit at 30-Jun-2026.

items.label: Parent convertibles (context only)
items.text: 1.75% convertible due May-2030 ($172.5mm, conversion price about $4.45); 0.00% convertible due Oct-2031 ($1.3bn, conversion price about $16.03); new 0.00% convertible due 1-Nov-2032 ($850mm base plus $150mm option, conversion price about $15.31, priced 14-Oct-2026, settlement scheduled 16-Oct-2026). These are senior unsecured parent obligations, structurally subordinated to the project notes at the asset level and not obligations of the issuer SPVs.

items.label: Tenant and guarantor
items.text: Amazon Data Services, Inc. (tenant); Amazon.com, Inc. (guarantor). The indenture calls the Amazon.com instrument a 'limited parent guarantee' dated 20-Mar-2026; the company's investor deck says it guarantees all base rent and operating expenses.

items.label: Lease
items.text: Datacenter lease dated 20-Mar-2026 between the subsidiary lessor and Amazon Data Services; second Amazon lease after Black Pearl. 15-year base term plus three five-year tenant extension options; triple net; Cipher bears de minimis operating cost (roof, slab, foundation). Base rent is abated until each phase commences.

items.label: Capacity
items.text: 70 MW critical IT on 100 MW gross at Andrews, Texas; company notes design efficiency may raise IT capacity.

items.label: Contracted rent
items.text: About $2.0bn of base-term lease payments (up to about $5.7bn with extensions), 3.0% annual escalator, about 100% NOI margin (company). Company illustration implies rent of about $112mm in 2028, about $1.6mm per IT MW (derived), consistent with seed $1.58mm.

items.label: Rent commencement
items.text: Network hall (10 IT MW) targeted 1-Apr-2027; data hall (60 IT MW) targeted 1-May-2027.

items.label: Termination and delay rights
items.text: No termination for convenience after commencement (company). Indenture treats termination of the lease or the guaranty as a termination event; other tenant termination and delay rights are in the lease, which was not reviewed.

items.label: Cost cap
items.text: Amazon covers construction costs above $10.5mm per IT MW (about $735mm for 70 MW, derived and equal to the seed facility cost).

items.label: Location
items.text: Andrews, Texas. Site acreage not found.

items.label: Capacity
items.text: 70 MW critical IT, 100 MW gross; adjacent 200 MW expansion potential (2030+, subject to ERCOT batch process).

items.label: Cost
items.text: Cost per IT MW cap $10.5mm; seed cost $735mm equals cap multiplied by MW rather than a budget, so total project cost including financing costs is not verified.

items.label: What the notes finance
items.text: Remaining cost of the Stingray facility, reimbursement of parent equity and debt service reserves; the company says the notes fully fund Stingray through substantial completion.

items.label: Interconnection
items.text: Substation electrical work had commenced by 5-May-2026, 'aligning with Q4 2026 target energization'. The utility and interconnection agreement were not named in the documents reviewed.

items.label: ERCOT Batch Zero
items.text: News reports ERCOT conditional classification (15-Sep-2026) of Stingray at 100 MW as conditional base load and Stingray Phase II at 200 MW as conditional studied load; final designations follow a Dec-2026 ERCOT audit and study results are scheduled for Apr-2027 per another outlet. It is not confirmed that the 100 MW is the notes' facility, though the size matches its gross capacity.

items.label: Behind-the-meter gas
items.text: Company pipeline pitch cites 2.5 GW of BTM potential and lateral gas pipelines at other sites; nothing indicates Stingray uses BTM gas.

items.label: Status
items.text: 30-Sep-2026: earthwork, grading and pad preparation on schedule, underground electrical work commenced, concrete foundations and steel erection underway. At 4-Aug-2026 about 75% of equipment secured and expected delivery 1H 2027.

items.label: Contractor
items.text: Not identified in the documents reviewed.

items.label: Overrun protection
items.text: Parent completion guarantee (notes proceeds plus prior equity) and the tenant's $10.5mm per IT MW cost cap.

items.label: Seed check
items.text: Seed construction start of May 2026 is contradicted: the Q1 deck of 5-May-2026 already shows earthwork and pad preparation in progress.

items.label: Debt
items.text: $810mm notes are the only project debt; no construction loan.

items.label: Reserves
items.text: Initial debt service reserve required $83.0mm (two interest payments, third interest payment and first installment, less estimated earnings).

items.label: Amortization and balloon (company illustration)
items.text: Illustrative: amortization about $27mm 2027, $45mm 2028, $51mm 2029, $57mm 2030, $64mm 2031; balance about $629mm at end-2030, i.e. roughly $0.6bn (about 70-75%) due at Jun-2031 maturity. Seed estimate of 25.8% amortized is consistent.

items.label: Leverage
items.text: Seed: 98% debt-funded, 7.3x at issuance, 4.9x at maturity; not verified.

items.label: Amazon.com guaranty
items.text: Limited parent guarantee dated 20-Mar-2026 of the tenant's payment obligations; marketing says it covers base rent and operating expenses.

items.label: Parent completion guarantee
items.text: Cipher will fund the issuer as needed to complete the facility.

items.label: Replacement tenant
items.text: A termination of the lease or guaranty becomes an Event of Default only if no Qualified Datacenter Lease is signed within the Datacenter Lease EoD Period of 6 months, extended to 12 months if a letter of intent with a Qualified Tenant exists and conditions (DSRA full, no distributions, funds for opex and capex, termination amounts held) are met.

items.label: Termination amounts
items.text: Any amount paid by the tenant on a lease termination (liquidated damages) must be held in a designated account; declined asset-sale/termination proceeds can be distributed only within limits.

items.label: Distributions after final commencement
items.text: Restricted payments allowed up to 40.0% of LTM net operating income, plus final excess equity amounts and retained excess cash flow; reimbursement of parent capex at closing.

items.label: Coverage tests
items.text: Target Project DSCR 1.25x drives amortization; Project DSCR below 1.10x permits a one-time par redemption (issuer option, not mandatory).

items.label: Events of default
items.text: Payment default (30 days for interest), covenant breach (60 days after notice), cross-default above $25mm, collateral invalidity, and lease/guaranty termination without a replacement lease in the EoD period.

items.label: Reporting
items.text: Annual conference call and periodic reports; unrestricted-parent calls can satisfy the requirement.

items.label: Moody's / Fitch
items.text: Company's Q2-2026 presentation shows Ba2 (Moody's) / BB- (Fitch); seed shows S&P NR. Agency releases not located.

items.label: Uses
items.text: (1) finance the remaining cost of the Stingray facility, (2) reimburse parent for prior equity contributions, (3) fund debt service reserves.

items.label: Energization
items.text: Substation targeted for Q4 2026 while the site's 100 MW sits in the ERCOT Batch Zero conditional list; a late or revised energization would pressure the Apr-May 2027 rent dates.

items.label: Schedule
items.text: About 75% of equipment secured at Aug-2026 and construction mid-stream; rent dates are a single-year window.

items.label: Balloon
items.text: Roughly 70-75% of principal is outstanding at Jun-2031 on illustrations.

items.label: Guaranty scope
items.text: Amazon guaranty is 'limited' in the indenture; breadth not verified.

items.label: Parent stress
items.text: Completion guarantee relies on the parent, which has $0.83bn cash but heavy near-term capex and a share-price drop around the Oct-2026 convertible.

items.label: Construction
items.text: Foundations and steel erection underway by 30-Sep-2026; underground electrical started in Q2.

items.label: Batch Zero
items.text: Conditional classification of the Stingray 100 MW and Phase II 200 MW (news).

items.label: Parent financing
items.text: 2032 convertible priced 14-Oct-2026 and 2030 exchange; shares fell about 12% on 13-Oct.
