GALAXY.title: Galaxy Helios Data Centers II LLC 9.875% Senior Secured Notes due 1-Aug-2031
GALAXY.headline: A $3.507bn five-year senior secured high-yield bond from a ring-fenced Galaxy Digital subsidiary financing Helios Phase II (400 MW utility / 260 MW critical IT, Dickens County TX), fully leased to CoreWeave for 15 years plus two 5-year options with about $10.4bn of minimum contracted rent. Galaxy's parent gives an uncapped completion guarantee tied to rent commencement (targeted Q2 2027) but no payment guarantee, and the company's own schedule leaves about $3.0bn due at the Aug 2031 maturity. It trades wide because all rent depends on CoreWeave, whose bonds sold off to distressed levels on 14-16 Oct 2026, and because ERCOT Batch Zero classification remains conditional.

items.label: Issuer
items.text: Galaxy Helios Data Centers II LLC, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Galaxy Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: GLXY).

items.label: Notes title / size
items.text: 9.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2031; $3,507mm aggregate principal; sold under a 23 Jul 2026 purchase agreement (representative: Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC) at 99.500% of par; closed 28 Jul 2026.

items.label: Coupon and dates
items.text: 9.875% p.a., semi-annual in arrears on 1 Feb and 1 Aug, first payment 1 Feb 2027; maturity 1 Aug 2031.

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: Seed shows ISIN US36322DAA46, CUSIP 36322DAA4 (144A). Not shown in the 8-K or indenture text.

items.label: Ranking and security
items.text: Senior secured. First-priority liens on substantially all assets of the Issuer and the Guarantor (excluded property carved out) and on all Issuer equity held by its direct parent (HoldCo).

items.label: Guarantor and HoldCo
items.text: Guarantor: Galaxy Helios II LLC (direct wholly-owned subsidiary of the Issuer). HoldCo: Galaxy Helios II Qualified Opportunity Zone Business, LLC (direct parent of the Issuer, party to the indenture). Galaxy Digital Inc. does not guarantee the notes.

items.label: Amortization
items.text: Semi-annual on 1 Feb / 1 Aug at rates set out in the indenture; first payment on the Amortization Commencement Date, i.e. the first payment date after the date that is 10 months after rent is first paid following the Commencement Date (all data halls delivered).

items.label: Illustrative amortization (company)
items.text: Company illustrative schedule (July 2026 presentation, calendar-year amounts, $mm): 2028 12; 2029 140; 2030 140; 2031 167; 2032 227; 2033 262; 2034 300; 2035 342; 2036 388; 2037 439; 2038 495; 2039 556; 2040 40. This runs far beyond the Aug 2031 maturity, so about $3.0bn would remain at maturity unless refinanced (derived: year-end 2030 balance $3,215mm less 2031 amortization).

items.label: Optional redemption
items.text: Make-whole before 1 Aug 2028; call prices 104.938% (2028), 102.469% (2029), par (2030+). Before 1 Aug 2028: up to 40% with equity proceeds at 109.875%; up to 10% of original principal per calendar year at 103.000%.

items.label: Other redemption / offers
items.text: Par redemption on a Data Center Lease Termination Event; one-time par redemption down to 1.10x DSCR if DSCR is below 1.10x after the Commencement Date; 100% of any lease termination fee must be offered to holders at par; asset-sale proceeds offered at par; Change of Control Trigger Event put at 101%.

items.label: Trustee / collateral agent
items.text: The Bank of New York Mellon.

items.label: Offering format
items.text: Rule 144A / Regulation S private offering.

items.label: Ownership chain
items.text: Galaxy Digital Inc. -> Galaxy Digital Holdings LP (GDH LP, indirect parent) -> ... -> HoldCo (Galaxy Helios II Qualified Opportunity Zone Business, LLC) -> Issuer (Galaxy Helios Data Centers II LLC) -> Guarantor (Galaxy Helios II LLC). Landlord under the CoreWeave lease is Galaxy Power LLC; the lease was assigned to the Landlord (project entity) via an Assignment and Assumption Agreement.

items.label: Ring-fencing
items.text: Covenants restrict non-project assets/operations, becoming a general partner, or acquiring/forming subsidiaries without a Rating Agency Confirmation; special-purpose-entity and HoldCo negative covenants (Sections 4.17-4.20).

items.label: Tax structure
items.text: Indenture permits tax distributions needed to maintain REIT status of the Issuer or its parent, and refers to a Qualified Opportunity Zone Business parent.

items.label: Credit support in the presentation
items.text: Company states only the Issuer, the Guarantor and the 400 MW utility / 260 MW critical IT project provide credit support for the notes; other Galaxy projects and Helios I do not.

items.label: Structure in words
items.text: CoreWeave pays rent to the project Landlord; Landlord/Issuer/Guarantor ring-fenced; Galaxy LP provides an uncapped completion guarantee tied to rent commencement; no parent payment guarantee.

items.label: Sponsor
items.text: Galaxy Digital Inc. (NASDAQ/TSX: GLXY), New York; digital-asset financial services plus Helios data center campus in Dickens County, West Texas (first notes in the HY market).

items.label: Parent financial position (30 Jun 2026)
items.text: Total assets $10.84bn; total equity $2.72bn; cash and stablecoins $2.46bn (cash $896mm, stablecoins $1,563mm); Data Centers segment assets $2.54bn.

items.label: Parent earnings
items.text: Q2 2026 net loss $85.3mm (H1 net loss $301.6mm); Adjusted EBITDA $(77.3)mm in Q2 and $(264.8)mm in H1.

items.label: Phase I financing (separate SPV)
items.text: Galaxy Helios I LLC: Deutsche Bank AG senior secured term loan up to $1.4bn (15 Aug 2025), SOFR + 4.75% with 2.50% floor, commitments mature 15 Aug 2028, $1.3bn drawn at 30 Jun 2026; covenants: min DSCR 1.40x after Stabilization, max 80% loan-to-cost, GDH LP tangible net worth at least the loan amount and liquidity at least 10% of the loan (5% on conditions). Not part of the notes' collateral.

items.label: Other parent debt
items.text: Exchangeable notes (2026, 2029 and 2031 series appear in the 10-Q XBRL tags; amounts not extracted).

items.label: Helios campus scale
items.text: ERCOT-approved power at Helios over 1.6 GW (about 800 MW leased to CoreWeave across Phases I-III plus 830 MW uncontracted); campus over 2,200 acres per news.

items.label: Tenant
items.text: CoreWeave, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRWV) for the entire project; lease agreement dated 8 Aug 2025 between Galaxy Power LLC (landlord) and CoreWeave, amended by a First Amendment (21 Jan 2026) and Second Amendment (3 Jun 2026). Whether any CoreWeave SPV or parent guarantee stands behind the lease is not stated in the filings reviewed.

items.label: Term and extensions
items.text: 15-year base term plus two 5-year CoreWeave extension options (company presentation). Seed agrees (15 yrs, two 5-yr).

items.label: Rent and escalator
items.text: Minimum contracted lease payments of $10.4bn over the base term (remaining payments; excludes a $100mm option payment already received; assumes 3% CPI); annual escalator 3.0% if CPI below 3%, 5.0% if CPI above 5%, CPI in between. Illustrative rent $155mm (2027), $472mm (2028), $565mm (2029), $582mm (2030), $599mm (2031).

items.label: Yield on cost
items.text: Starting monthly recurring charge gross yield on cost of 13.7% (company figure, flagged by company as target).

items.label: Lease type
items.text: 'Near triple net': tenant pays utilities, taxes, insurance, maintenance and ordinary repairs, excluding personnel costs provided by Galaxy for mechanical/cooling/electrical/admin functions outside white space. NOI margin about 90%+ after operating expenses of $15 per kW per month. Seed calls it modified gross.

items.label: Rent commencement
items.text: Initial targeted rent commencement Q2 2027 (company does not guarantee); rent is phase-by-phase as data halls reach their 'Data Hall Commencement Date'; the indenture's Commencement Date is the date all data halls have commenced.

items.label: Termination and replacement
items.text: A Data Center Lease Termination Event followed by no Qualifying Data Center Lease with a Qualifying Tenant within 6 months (12 months if LOI, full DSRA, no discretionary distributions, opex funded, termination fee retained) is an Event of Default. Termination fees go to a Designated Account and must be offered to holders at par.

items.label: Qualifying Tenant
items.text: NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta (or controlled affiliates); listed tech/hyperscaler with EV or market cap of at least $50bn; a tenant with qualifying backstop; or anyone for whom a Rating Agency Confirmation is obtained (clause iv). CoreWeave is not on the named list; Oracle is not listed here (unlike the CORZ indenture).

items.label: Tenant credit backers (company claims)
items.text: NVIDIA holds about 11.5% of CoreWeave and is obligated to purchase up to $6.3bn of residual CoreWeave cloud capacity through April 2032 (company presentation); CoreWeave revenue backlog $99.4bn at Q1 2026, market cap $43.6bn at 14 Jul 2026.

items.label: Tenant-side disclosure
items.text: CoreWeave's 10-Q describes an unnamed single-site lease with 393 MW undelivered at 30 Jun 2026 (phased 2026-2028), rent based on lessor construction cost with a contractual maximum of $14.7bn over a 16-year term. The 393 MW equals Galaxy's Phase II+III (260+133 MW), so it appears to be this campus, but CoreWeave does not name the lessor (inference).

items.label: Prepaid rent
items.text: $150mm of prepaid rent (deferred lease revenue) held by Galaxy at 30 Jun 2026 and 31 Dec 2025 (Data Centers segment).

items.label: Assignment / SLA credits
items.text: Not disclosed in filings reviewed.

items.label: Project
items.text: Two buildings with eight data halls: 400 MW utility (gross) and 260 MW critical IT, 'Helios I, Phase II' (also called Project Speed Phase II), on Galaxy's Dickens County TX campus.

items.label: Acreage (discrepancy)
items.text: 8-K says approximately 260-acre property; the July 2026 presentation says 196-acre property; campus is over 2,200 acres per press. Recorded as unreconciled.

items.label: Phase I (outside the notes)
items.text: 133 MW critical IT / about 200 MW gross delivered to CoreWeave; rent commenced and scaled up through Q2 2026.

items.label: Phase III
items.text: A further 133 MW critical IT is leased to CoreWeave under the Phase III lease (393 MW total Phase II+III, expected delivery from Q2 2027) but is not financed by these notes; CoreWeave has committed 526 MW critical IT across Phases I-III.

items.label: Cost / per MW
items.text: Seed: facility cost $3,617mm, about $13.9mm per critical MW, debt about 85% of cost. Company presentation cites 13.7% starting MRC gross yield on cost; cost figure itself not verified from official documents.

items.label: Cooling / density
items.text: Not disclosed in the filings reviewed.

items.label: What the notes finance
items.text: A portion of development and construction of the project plus debt service reserves; remainder from prior equity contributions and GDH LP completion support.

items.label: Grid approvals
items.text: ERCOT approved an additional 830 MW at Helios on 15 Jan 2026 after a Large Load Interconnection Study (steady-state and stability studies); Galaxy executed a service agreement with AEP Texas Inc.; Wind Energy Transmission Texas, LLC is the transmission interconnection provider. Total approved at Helios over 1.6 GW (1.63 GW).

items.label: Batch Zero
items.text: On 8 Sep 2026 Galaxy said Helios I (800 MW) and Helios II (830 MW) received conditional Batch Zero classification as Base Load; Helios II was approved in January 2026 before the 4 Mar validation date and Galaxy states it remains on schedule to energize in 2028; Helios III (1,000 MW) is Studied Load.

items.label: Batch Zero caveats
items.text: Classifications are conditional; a 3 Aug 2026 gubernatorial directive led the PUCT on 20 Aug to grant ERCOT exceptions while it audits queued data-center projects (several months); no replacement date set for Batch Zero study results; projects can be removed. Galaxy flags these as interconnection risk.

items.label: Phase II power timing
items.text: 600 MW of gross capacity supports the 393 MW (Phase II+III) leases, expected to be delivered starting Q2 2027 per 10-Q; the 830 MW tranche is said to energize in 2028.

items.label: Which MW supports the notes
items.text: Project is 400 MW utility capacity. The filings reviewed do not map the 400 MW to the 600 MW / 830 MW tranches; the 2028 energization date for the 830 MW tranche versus the Q2 2027 rent start is an open timing question.

items.label: Contractor
items.text: The task brief named HITT Contracting. No official document or press item I could access names HITT or any general contractor for Phase II; not verified.

items.label: Phase I performance
items.text: Company states Phase I was delivered on schedule (press: also on budget).

items.label: Phase II status
items.text: Greenfield development underway with civil and structural work; data hall deliveries expected to commence in H1 2027; initial targeted rent commencement Q2 2027.

items.label: Completion guarantee
items.text: Uncapped completion guarantee from Galaxy Digital Holdings LP (dated 28 Jul 2026) to provide the Landlord funds so that each phase required to be delivered to CoreWeave satisfies all conditions to rent commencement, if notes proceeds and other available funds (incl. prior equity contributions) are insufficient.

items.label: Construction period reserve
items.text: DSRA initially sized using $285.05mm for construction-period interest net of expected NOI plus next interest and the first installment; rises or falls with schedule.

items.label: Contract type
items.text: GMP/fixed-price status unknown.

items.label: Notes
items.text: $3,507mm at 99.5 (net proceeds not stated); no other tranche at the Issuer disclosed.

items.label: Illustrative annual summary (company, $mm)
items.text: Rent 155 / 472 / 565 / 582 / 599 for 2027-2031; NOI 120 / 424 / 516 / 531 / 547; net interest 117 / 290 / 284 / 272 / 260; cash flow after debt service 4 / 122 / 92 / 119 / 121; cumulative post-debt-service cash flow $457mm through 2031.

items.label: Derived coverage
items.text: NOI / (net interest + amortization): about 1.40x (2028), 1.22x (2029), 1.29x (2030), 1.28x (2031). Derived from the company's illustrative table; actual covenants differ.

items.label: Derived leverage
items.text: Debt / NOI about 6.5x on 2029 NOI ($3,355mm / $516mm); seed shows 7.0x at issuance and 5.6x at maturity.

items.label: Debt vs equity
items.text: Seed: 85% debt-funded; indenture counts 'prior equity contributions' and DSRA but no equity amount disclosed.

items.label: Refinancing risk
items.text: Notes mature Aug 2031 but company amortization schedule runs to 2040: about $3.0bn balloon, roughly 85% of original principal.

items.label: Interest burden
items.text: About $345mm per year coupon at 9.875% on $3,507mm (derived); construction-period interest funded from notes proceeds and DSRA.

items.label: Completion guarantee
items.text: See Construction. Uncapped, from GDH LP, tied to rent-commencement conditions.

items.label: Debt service reserve
items.text: Construction period: $285.05mm estimate-based formula plus next interest and first installment; after construction: next interest plus next installment; letters of credit allowed; step-down if notes become investment grade.

items.label: Lease termination protection
items.text: 6-12 month re-let window, Rating Agency Confirmation, par redemption and termination-fee offer.

items.label: Tenant-side support
items.text: NVIDIA residual capacity purchase obligation (up to $6.3bn through Apr 2032) supports CoreWeave, not the lease itself; no direct guarantee of the lease by NVIDIA found.

items.label: Parent recourse
items.text: None for debt service; only the completion guarantee.

items.label: Restricted payments
items.text: After the Commencement Date, distributions capped at 40% of trailing four-quarter NOI plus (Full Budgeted Cost of Construction minus notes issued) plus similar amounts for any Additional Project; tax distributions (incl. to maintain REIT status) allowed only if the DSRA is fully funded; no distributions through the Data Center Lease EoD Period.

items.label: Project accounts / waterfall
items.text: Notes Proceeds Account (construction), Revenue Account, Debt Service Reserve Account, Designated Account (termination fees); revenue applied in priority order in Section 4.23(g); excess DSRA may be released to a distribution account.

items.label: DSCR
items.text: DSCR defined on forward four-quarter NOI over required debt service; DSCR below 1.10x after the Commencement Date gives the Issuer a one-time par redemption right (no lock-up level extracted).

items.label: Other covenants
items.text: Debt, liens, investments, affiliate transactions, asset sales, mergers; no change to the Data Center Lease without compliance with Section 4.21; Rating Agency Confirmation needed for non-project assets or new subsidiaries.

items.label: Cross-default / EoD
items.text: Customary events of default; Data Center Lease Termination Event of Default as above.

items.label: Seed ratings
items.text: NR / BB- / BB- (Moody's / S&P / Fitch ordering as given by Barclays).

items.label: Agency documents
items.text: No S&P or Fitch release found or accessible; outlooks, rationale and triggers unverified. Indenture contemplates step-downs if the notes are rated investment grade and uses Rating Agency Confirmation.

items.label: Stated use
items.text: Finance a portion of development and construction of two buildings (eight data halls, 400 MW utility / 260 MW critical IT) on the Dickens County property and fund debt service reserves.

items.label: Group usage statement
items.text: Galaxy's Q2 release says proceeds fund construction of Helios I, Phase II.

items.label: Single tenant, sub-IG, now under market stress
items.text: All revenue is CoreWeave rent; CoreWeave bonds sold off to distressed levels on 14-16 Oct 2026 (see CRWV dossier).

items.label: Rent not yet flowing
items.text: First rent targeted Q2 2027; interest is paid from proceeds/DSRA until then; delay raises completion-guarantee draw and DSRA need.

items.label: Interconnection conditionality
items.text: Batch Zero classifications are conditional; PUCT-ordered audit; no study result date; Galaxy flags removal risk.

items.label: Power timing mismatch
items.text: 2028 energization for the 830 MW tranche versus Q2 2027 rent start; mapping of the notes' 400 MW to specific approvals not disclosed.

items.label: Balloon
items.text: About $3.0bn due Aug 2031 per company schedule.

items.label: Completion guarantee strength
items.text: Backed by GDH LP, whose group had Q2 2026 losses; group liquidity $2.46bn cash/stablecoins but also funds Helios I ($1.3bn loan drawn) and Phase III.

items.label: Lease cost-based rent
items.text: CoreWeave describes rent as based on lessor construction cost with a contractual maximum ($14.7bn for 393 MW), so minimum rent may move with cost.

items.label: Replacement tenant hurdle
items.text: CoreWeave not a Qualifying Tenant by name; replacement requires hyperscaler-type tenant or ratings confirmation.

items.label: Contractor unknown
items.text: HITT or other GC not confirmed.

items.label: Closing and Q2
items.text: Notes closed 28 Jul 2026; Q2 results 5 Aug 2026 (net loss $85.3mm; first lease revenue in Q2).

items.label: Batch Zero
items.text: 8 Sep 2026 conditional Base Load classification for Helios I/II; Helios III Studied Load; Caspian and Selene Studied Load.

items.label: Management
items.text: Chief Accounting Officer Robert Rico resigned effective 30 Sep 2026; Dritan Muneka appointed Corporate Controller/PAO (8-K 23 Sep 2026).

items.label: Tenant stress
items.text: 14-16 Oct 2026: CoreWeave bonds at distressed levels; CEO memo says backlog covers debt; no Galaxy response found.

ELKGVP.title: Elk Grove Village Property LLC 7.50% Notes due Jun-2031 (144A)
ELKGVP.headline: $900mm 5-year 7.5% notes of a Prime Data Centers SPV financing a 72MW build-to-suit data center in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, reported to be fully leased to CoreWeave for 15 years (about $2.2bn of rent). Credit is effectively CoreWeave (S&P B+/positive) plus re-letting value in the Chicago market; rated Ba3/BB-/BB- per Moody's, S&P and Fitch (secondary sources). About 20% amortizes in the 5-year life, leaving a large 2031 refinancing. All primary documents are private, so most terms are press-sourced.

items.label: Issuer
items.text: Elk Grove Village Property LLC, a wholly owned indirect subsidiary of Prime Data Centers LLC.

items.label: Notes title / size
items.text: 7.50% notes due 2031, $900mm aggregate principal, Rule 144A. Launched at $850mm and upsized by $50mm (press reports); Cahill confirms $900mm.

items.label: Ranking / security
items.text: Cahill describes 'senior notes' and does not say secured; Creditflow and CCIR list the issue as Senior Secured. Collateral package (liens, mortgage, equity pledge) not confirmed from an official document.

items.label: Coupon / pricing
items.text: 7.50%; priced at par to yield 7.5%, at the low end of talk. Pricing date 2-Jun-2026 per ledger; Cahill release dated 9-Jun-2026 (seed issue date 9-Jun is probably settlement/announcement, unverified).

items.label: Maturity / tenor
items.text: 5-year tenor; Jun 2031 per ledger; seed gives 15-Jun-2031 (exact day unverified).

items.label: Call schedule
items.text: Ledger shows a 2-year call (non-call to about Jun 2028). Seed: first call 15-Jun-2028 at 103.75 (half the coupon). Make-whole terms not seen.

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: Seed: ISIN US28734DAA37, CUSIP 28734DAA3 (144A). Not verified against an official document; Reg S identifiers not found.

items.label: Amortization
items.text: Reported that about 20% of project debt amortizes during the five-year term, leaving a large refinancing balloon. Seed estimate 19.5%, amortization starting mid-2027. Schedule itself not seen.

items.label: Bookrunner
items.text: Banco Santander (sole manager / bookrunner per ledger and press).

items.label: Trustee, governing law, denominations
items.text: Not found (indenture and offering memorandum are not public).

items.label: Borrower SPV
items.text: Elk Grove Village Property LLC is the single-asset borrower for the Chicago-area build-to-suit data center leased to CoreWeave; indirect subsidiary of Prime Data Centers LLC.

items.label: Guarantors / ring-fencing
items.text: Not disclosed publicly. Structure of equity pledge, subsidiary guarantees and separateness covenants could not be verified without the offering memorandum.

items.label: Related Prime financing
items.text: Creditflow-sourced ledger lists a separate $500mm Norwegian-law bond by Prime Data Centers that was postponed (relationship to this deal not stated).

items.label: Prime Data Centers
items.text: Developer and operator of hyperscale and purpose-built data centers (Cahill release); first Illinois campus and first outside California. Private; no public financials.

items.label: Campus plan
items.text: Prime announced a $1bn, three-building campus at 1600 E Higgins Rd, Elk Grove Village (175MW at full build-out per Prime release; Clune page says 275MW; Baxtel 275 MVA). ORD-01 is the first building.

items.label: Capital position
items.text: No public information on Prime's equity contribution, liquidity or other debt beyond this note and the postponed Norwegian bond.

items.label: Tenant
items.text: CoreWeave, Inc. is reported as the sole tenant, fully leasing the building. No CoreWeave filing or press release confirms the lease (10-Qs checked).

items.label: Term and extensions
items.text: 15-year lease with two 7-year renewal options covering the entire premises and critical IT power (Bloomberg, anonymous source). Seed agrees (15 yrs, two 7-yr extensions).

items.label: Lease type
items.text: CoreWeave pays substantially all operating costs including power, utilities and taxes, i.e. triple-net-style. Seed: Triple Net.

items.label: Rent / value
items.text: About $2.2bn of revenue over the 15-year term (single anonymous source). Seed: $1.69mm per MW per year, 3.0% escalator.

items.label: Consistency check
items.text: 72MW x $1.69mm/MW = about $122mm in year 1; with 3% annual escalators over 15 years this sums to about $2.26bn, consistent with the reported ~$2.2bn (own calculation using seed rent).

items.label: Tenant credit
items.text: CoreWeave: S&P B+ with positive outlook (reported); Fitch BB-/Positive as of Apr 2026. S&P reportedly rates the project above CoreWeave because the building could be re-let in a strong Chicago market (the BB- on notes vs B+ tenant).

items.label: Guarantor / credit support
items.text: No parent guarantee or third-party support reported. Delay/termination rights, SLA credits, assignment rights: not found.

items.label: Lease commencement
items.text: Seed: rent commencement between Oct 2025 and early 2027 (phased). Not verified; consistent with phased data hall delivery.

items.label: Debt
items.text: $900mm notes. Seed: leverage 7.4x at issuance falling to 5.4x at maturity, ~90% debt funded. Not verified.

items.label: Refinancing risk
items.text: 5-year notes against a 15-year lease with only ~20% amortization means about 80% of the balance must be refinanced in 2031.

items.label: Other facilities and reserves
items.text: DSRA, construction facility details and equity: not found.

items.label: Re-leasing support
items.text: Single-asset, single-tenant: S&P gives credit for the building's re-leasability in the Chicago market; no third-party residual value guarantee reported.

items.label: Parent recourse
items.text: None reported; completion guarantee status unknown.

items.label: Terms
items.text: Covenants, waterfall, DSCR tests, lock-up and EoD could not be sourced (indenture not public).

items.label: Moody's
items.text: Ba3 (first-time rating; credit opinion dated 5-Jun-2026; document not read).

items.label: S&P

items.label: Fitch
items.text: BB- per ledger only; no Fitch release found.

items.label: Uses
items.text: Refinance existing debt (about $500mm incl. accrued interest), fund remaining construction costs, and other corporate purposes if any proceeds remain.

items.label: Single-tenant concentration
items.text: Entire credit rests on CoreWeave (S&P B+/pos, Fitch BB-/pos). A CoreWeave downgrade is a direct risk.

items.label: Refinancing
items.text: Roughly 80% balloon in Jun 2031 against a 15-year lease.

items.label: Documentation opacity
items.text: Lease terms, SLA credits, termination rights and covenants are unpublished; only press accounts are available.

items.label: Unconfirmed lease
items.text: CoreWeave has not acknowledged the lease in the filings checked.

items.label: Post-issuance news

SECMOS.title: SE Cosmos, LLC 8.875% Senior Secured Notes due 1-May-2031 (144A/Reg S)
SECMOS.headline: $999mm bullet notes of SB Energy's SE Cosmos, LLC financing the ~50MW Cosmos Technology Campus on the former 3M site in Austin (Travis County), Texas, leased 15 years triple-net to SoftBank affiliate Silver Bands 3 (US) Corp. with a SoftBank Group Capital Limited guaranty (about $2.9bn exposure), plus an uncapped completion guaranty from parent Energy Global. Credit rests on SoftBank-group support and on-time delivery (rent by 11-Dec-2026 or RFS; full RFS May 2027), not on OpenAI or Milam County, which are separate SB Energy projects.

items.label: Issuer
items.text: SE Cosmos, LLC, a Delaware LLC; direct wholly owned subsidiary of Cosmos Pledgor, LLC ('HoldCo'); indirect subsidiary of Energy Global, LP ('Parent').

items.label: Notes
items.text: $999,000,000 8.875% Senior Secured Notes due 1-May-2031; indenture dated 7-May-2026; offered under Rule 144A and Regulation S; the issuer's inaugural high-yield offering.

items.label: Pricing
items.text: Issued at 99.500% of par; yield to maturity 9.002%; net proceeds about $994.0mm. (Seed 9.66% yield on 15-Sep-2026 is the secondary-market level.)

items.label: Coupon / payment dates
items.text: Fixed 8.875% per annum, semi-annual in arrears on 1 May and 1 Nov (record dates 15 Apr and 15 Oct). First coupon 1-Nov-2026 (inferred). Semi-annual coupon is about $44.3mm (own calculation).

items.label: Ranking / security
items.text: First-priority lien on substantially all assets of the issuer: pledge of issuer equity by Cosmos Pledgor, LLC, mortgages on real property and a security agreement over personal property; accounts under control of the collateral agent.

items.label: Guarantors
items.text: Future subsidiaries of the issuer only; the issuer had no subsidiaries at issue date. Notes are solely obligations of the issuer, not guaranteed by SB Energy, Inc. or other subsidiaries. Non-recourse to the sponsor apart from the completion guaranty.

items.label: Redemption
items.text: Before 1-May-2028: par plus Applicable Premium (make-whole, Treasury-based; spread not extracted). Equity clawback up to 40% at 108.875% within 180 days of an equity offering, with at least 50% remaining. Up to 10% of original principal per calendar year at 103.000% before 1-May-2028. Call prices from 1-May-2028: 104.438% (2028), 102.219% (2029), 100% (2030 on). Also redeemable after a Data Center Lease Termination Event (price shown as 100.000%, remainder of clause not extracted). Seed call price 104.44 matches.

items.label: Mandatory amortization
items.text: None: no mandatory prepayment or sinking fund; bullet at 1-May-2031. Affiliates may buy notes in the open market. Seed 'N/A' amortization confirmed.

items.label: Change of control
items.text: Put at 101% only if a Change of Control (loss of operational control by Parent/affiliates or a Qualified Operator) coincides with a Ratings Decline (downgrade by at least two agencies attributed to the event).

items.label: Denominations, trustee, law
items.text: Minimum $2,000 and $1,000 multiples; Wilmington Trust, National Association as trustee and collateral agent; New York law; DTC / Euroclear / Clearstream.

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: Seed: ISIN US78438PAA03, CUSIP 78438PAA0 (144A); the indenture refers to CUSIP/ISIN numbers generically (Section 2.13); no number found in text. Not verified.

items.label: Structure in words
items.text: SE Cosmos, LLC owns the Cosmos Technology Campus and is landlord under the SoftBank-affiliate lease; its equity is pledged by Cosmos Pledgor, LLC; above sits Energy Global, LP, which gives the completion guaranty; SB Energy, Inc. (SoftBank-controlled, proposed Nasdaq 'SBE') is the listed parent group.

items.label: Special purpose
items.text: Indenture contains SPE, HoldCo negative-pledge, affiliate-transaction and no-modification-of-lease covenants.

items.label: Bridge
items.text: $425mm bridge loan agreed 31-Mar-2026; $342.3mm drawn 1-Apr-2026; repaid in full from note proceeds.

items.label: SB Energy
items.text: SoftBank-controlled developer of solar, storage and (new) data center campuses; S-1 filed 1-Sep-2026 for a Nasdaq 'SBE' IPO. SoftBank and OpenAI are strategic investors and customers; NVIDIA is a strategic investor ($1.5bn prepaid forward dated 17-Aug-2026 for Class N shares at IPO).

items.label: Data center footprint
items.text: 8.8 GW-IT of signed data center leases across three campuses, all with SoftBank or OpenAI affiliates and no unaffiliated tenant: Cosmos (50MW, SoftBank), Milam County Buildings 1 and 2 (308MW + 445MW, OpenAI), PORTS-Pike, Ohio (8,024MW, OpenAI, executed Aug 2026). No data center capacity is operating yet.

items.label: Sponsor leverage and obligations
items.text: About $3.7bn of construction in progress at 30-Jun-2026; project loans for Libra, Athos and Cosmos of about $4.1bn closed in H1 2026; Hickory facilities $473mm are corporate-recourse; intercompany notes $709.5mm to be repaid from IPO. Some completion and performance guarantees are recourse to the parent.

items.label: Related-party concentration
items.text: Leases are with related parties; SoftBank holds a controlling interest and board designation rights, so a dispute with SoftBank/OpenAI would be a conflict-laden enforcement.

items.label: Tenant
items.text: Silver Bands 3 (US) Corp., a Delaware corporation, an affiliate of SoftBank (named in the indenture; the S-1 says 'affiliate of SoftBank'). The tenant is SoftBank-side, not OpenAI: OpenAI affiliates lease Milam County and PORTS-Pike, which are separate and do not back these notes.

items.label: Lease guarantor
items.text: SoftBank Group Capital Limited (England and Wales, a SoftBank Group affiliate) guarantees the tenant's obligations; anticipated aggregate guaranty exposure about $2.9bn. The indenture treats loss of the guarantee, or guarantor tangible net worth below $5bn, as a Lease Guarantee Event.

items.label: Lease date and term
items.text: Lease dated 7-Nov-2025; 15-year initial term, one 10-year renewal option (seed 15 yrs + one 10-yr confirmed). Triple net with 100% operating expense pass-through.

items.label: Rent
items.text: Rent set as a percentage return on total project cost with annual escalators; expected aggregate rent about $2.5bn over 15 years. Seed: $2.63mm per MW per year, 3.0% escalator; check: 50MW x $2.63mm = about $131mm in year 1; 15 years at 3% escalation sums to about $2.45bn, consistent with about $2.5bn.

items.label: Commencement
items.text: Rent commences by phase on the earlier of 11-Dec-2026 or the phase achieving RFS (substantial completion, tenant acceptance, certifications, commissioning). Four phases; the final is 'Phase 4 (Sirius III)'. Full RFS by May 2027. Company expects first phase revenue in Q4 2026.

items.label: Termination and delay rights
items.text: Limited tenant termination rights. For milestone failures (design documents, early access, substantial/final completion) remedies may include liquidated damages, rent credits, self-help, buy-out rights or repayment of advances. Exact Cosmos caps and dates not available (the lease was not among the exhibits reviewed).

items.label: Use by tenant
items.text: Described as renovated to support tenants' needs including R&D and engineering for advanced AI compute. SB Energy told local press it is an R&D center, the building application lists office/lab, and Graphcore (SoftBank-owned) placed its US engineering HQ there (Aug 2026).

items.label: Third-party support
items.text: No NVIDIA or hyperscaler residual-value guaranty at Cosmos. The NVIDIA RVG applies only to the PORTS-Pike campus.

items.label: Location (reconciled)
items.text: Cosmos Technology Campus is in Travis County, Texas (Austin / Four Points, 6801 River Place Blvd), the former 3M campus (Highpoint 2222 / Highpoint Mega Campus). Milam County is a different, OpenAI-leased campus (308MW + 445MW) not financed by these notes. Barclays' 'Austin, TX' is correct; 'Milam County' conflates the sponsor's other project.

items.label: Land and buildings
items.text: 156 acres, about 1.2mm sq ft of former office and lab space, vacant since 2019; SE Cosmos bought the property from Karlin Real Estate on 20-Mar-2026 (price not stated; one report cites $285.6mm, unverified).

items.label: Capacity
items.text: About 50MW critical IT (S-1) / 70MW utility capacity (Milbank). Seed 50MW confirmed.

items.label: Cost
items.text: Seed: facility cost $1,180mm ($23.6mm per MW), 84% debt-funded; notes $999mm / $1,180mm = 85% (own check). Cost not found in the S-1 extracts reviewed.

items.label: Project financing
items.text: Notes plus bridge refinancing; DCD reports about $1bn financing.

items.label: Grid
items.text: ERCOT market; Austin Energy (municipal utility) is completing substation and transmission upgrades needed for grid connection. Interconnection described as 'utility and ISO secured'; energization of certain Texas projects remains subject to the ERCOT/PUCT audit and verification process.

items.label: Permits
items.text: Company says all material permits for construction have been obtained, with no material delays as of the prospectus date. The local building application describes office/lab use; Austin has no dedicated data center rules yet.

items.label: Status
items.text: Vertical construction; notice to proceed issued March 2026 (seed: Feb 2026); initial operations expected Q4 2026; full RFS by May 2027.

items.label: Contractor and contract type
items.text: Not found in documents reviewed.

items.label: Completion support
items.text: Energy Global gives an uncapped completion guaranty for project completion only (not a guarantee of the notes), for the benefit of the noteholders (via the collateral agent) and the tenant; it is a senior unsecured obligation of Energy Global.

items.label: Debt
items.text: $999mm notes, non-recourse to the sponsor group other than the completion guaranty. Seed: leverage 7.6x at issuance, 7.1x at maturity (unverified).

items.label: Uses of net proceeds
items.text: Repay the $342.3mm bridge, finance construction, fund the Debt Service Reserve Account, pay fees. Remaining construction funding after bridge repayment is about $650mm before DSRA and fees (own calculation); sponsor equity amount not disclosed.

items.label: Refinancing
items.text: Bullet in May 2031 against a 15-year lease: full balloon at maturity (no amortization); seed leverage of 7.1x at maturity implies refinancing at high leverage.

items.label: Debt incurrence
items.text: After initial commencement, credit-facility debt up to $25mm plus 50% of trailing NOI; refinancing and certain other baskets permitted.

items.label: SoftBank Group Capital guaranty
items.text: Guaranty of tenant lease obligations, about $2.9bn anticipated exposure; the indenture requires a replacement guarantor to have TNW of at least $5bn and a rating of at least BB+ (S&P/Fitch) or Ba2.

items.label: Completion guaranty
items.text: Uncapped, from Energy Global, LP; the Ratings Decline definition references assumption by a Replacement Completion Guarantor.

items.label: Replacement tenant
items.text: Qualifying Tenant: NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta (or controlled affiliates), or a NYSE/Nasdaq-listed hyperscaler/tech company with EV or market cap of at least $50bn, or noteholder majority approval; Rating Agency Confirmation required.

items.label: Accounts
items.text: Notes Proceeds Account, Revenue Account, Debt Service Reserve Account and Designated Account (lease termination fee) under collateral agent control.

items.label: DSRA
items.text: During construction: $96.0mm (two coupons) less interest paid since issue, plus next payment's interest; after construction: next scheduled interest payment (about $44.3mm, own calculation). May be funded with cash, LCs or equity proceeds.

items.label: Distributions
items.text: Restricted payments permitted when forward NOI / debt service DSCR exceeds 1.10x (and does not fall below 1.10x after the payment), plus other baskets (equity proceeds, retained excess cash flow, etc.).

items.label: Events of default
items.text: 30-day interest default; principal default; covenant breach after 60-day cure (extendable to 90); cross-default above $25mm. Lease Termination EoD requires three events: lease ends, no Qualifying Data Center Lease within 6 months (12 with LOI and funded DSRA), and failure to make a Termination Fee Offer at par. Lease Guarantee EoD if the guarantee is lost or guarantor TNW falls below $5bn and no replacement within 6 months (12 with LOI).

items.label: Reporting
items.text: Periodic reporting covenant (Section 4.09); lease termination fees go to the Designated Account and must be offered to noteholders at 100%.

items.label: Seed ratings
items.text: NR / (P)BB / BB- (Moody's / S&P / Fitch ordering): not verified; no rating agency release found. DCD refers to an S&P note describing the site but the rating was not visible.

items.label: Context
items.text: The indenture defines Moody's, S&P and Fitch as Rating Agencies and uses 'Applicable Rating', so the notes are agency-rated. The lease guarantor is a SoftBank subsidiary and itself unrated per the indenture tests (it must be replaced by a BB+/Ba2 guarantor if lost).

items.label: Uses
items.text: Repay bridge ($342.3mm), build the Austin data center project, fund the DSRA, pay fees and expenses.

items.label: SoftBank concentration
items.text: Tenant, guarantor and sponsor are all SoftBank-related; SoftBank Group Capital's credit is the ultimate rent support.

items.label: Completion and delay
items.text: First revenue expected Q4 2026, full RFS May 2027. Rent starts on the earlier of 11-Dec-2026 or RFS; a late building defers phase rent while the tenant can claim liquidated damages, rent credits or buy-out rights.

items.label: Use and local opposition
items.text: Mixed R&D / data-center characterization, a building application listing office/lab, council questions and a 17-Sep town hall create permitting and reputational risk.

items.label: Power
items.text: Austin Energy substation/transmission upgrades must complete; ERCOT/PUCT audit applies to certain Texas projects.

items.label: Refinancing
items.text: Bullet maturity May 2031 against a 15-year lease.

items.label: Sponsor stress
items.text: Sponsor has $3.7bn construction in progress, recourse completion guarantees across Milam and PORTS-Pike, and depends on the IPO; parent distress would hit the completion guaranty.

items.label: Documentation
items.text: The lease and SoftBank guaranty documents were not in the exhibits reviewed; remedies are known only from the S-1 summary.

items.label: IPO filing
items.text: SB Energy filed an S-1 on 1-Sep-2026 (document dated 31-Aug), amended 21-Sep-2026; price range blank in the amendment reviewed. The NVIDIA prepaid forward and concurrent private placement are linked to the IPO.

items.label: Local scrutiny
items.text: Four Points News (3-Sep), council coverage (15-Sep) and a 17-Sep town hall raised questions on use and approvals.

items.label: Market level
items.text: Seed: 9.66% yield / +482bp on 15-Sep-2026.

items.label: Milestones ahead
items.text: Rent commencement outside date 11-Dec-2026; Q4 2026 first-phase revenue guidance.

WULF.title: WULF Compute LLC 7.750% Senior Secured Notes due 15-Oct-2030
WULF.headline: $3.2bn amortizing senior secured notes issued by TeraWulf's WULF Compute LLC to build Lake Mariner buildings CB-3, CB-4 and CB-5, leased for 10 years to Fluidstack with a Google backstop of about $3.2bn that becomes effective building by building as leases commence. $600mm of that support turned on in July 2026 when CB-3 was delivered; CB-4 is commissioning and CB-5 slipped to early 2027, and Fluidstack can terminate for delay beyond 180 days without triggering Google. Until commencement, support is TeraWulf's completion guarantee, a $447mm initial reserve and pledged Google warrants.

items.label: Issuer
items.text: WULF Compute LLC, a wholly owned indirect subsidiary of TeraWulf Inc.; direct parent is TeraWulf Brookings LLC.

items.label: Notes title and size
items.text: 7.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2030; $3,200mm aggregate principal, issued at 100% of principal; Rule 144A resale, Morgan Stanley sole initial purchaser/bookrunner under a purchase agreement dated 16-Oct-2025.

items.label: Coupon and payment dates
items.text: 7.750% per year, payable semiannually in arrears on 15 Apr and 15 Oct, first payment 15-Apr-2026. The 10-Q shows an effective interest rate of 8.7% including issuance costs of $105.4mm. Day-count convention not checked in the indenture.

items.label: Issue date and maturity
items.text: Indenture and Issue Date 23-Oct-2025 (the 10-Q describes the offering as completed 22-Oct-2025). Maturity 15-Oct-2030.

items.label: Original / current principal
items.text: Original $3,200mm. Per the 10-Q, principal payments start only after completion of the initial phase of the buildout (amortization per building starts at that building's Commencement Date), so outstanding is presumed still $3,200mm; not separately confirmed.

items.label: Ranking and security
items.text: Senior secured. First-priority liens on substantially all assets of WULF Compute and guarantors (excluded property carved out), all equity of WULF Compute held by Brookings, a designated Fluidstack lockbox account, and, during the construction period, Google's pledge of its TeraWulf warrants.

items.label: Optional redemption
items.text: Before 15-Oct-2027: 100% plus make-whole (Applicable Premium is the greater of 1.0% or a present-value amount). From 15-Oct-2027: 103.875%; from 15-Oct-2028: 101.938%; from 15-Oct-2029: par. Up to 40% may be redeemed before 15-Oct-2027 with proceeds of certain equity offerings.

items.label: Mandatory redemption / offers
items.text: (1) Datacenter Lease Termination Fee Mandatory Redemption: 100% of any Google termination fee received must redeem notes at par plus accrued. (2) Semiannual Excess Cash Flow Offer at par, Applicable ECF Percentage 50%. (3) Change of control offer at 101%.

items.label: Scheduled amortization
items.text: Semiannual on 15 Apr / 15 Oct, per building and only after that building's Commencement Date. Total amortization per measurement period: CB-3 $13.699mm (first 3 months) then $55.070mm, $56.171mm, $57.295mm, $58.441mm, $59.609mm (years 1-5); CB-4 $27.398mm then $110.140mm, $112.343mm, $114.589mm, $116.881mm, $119.219mm; CB-5 $31.964mm then $128.496mm, $131.066mm, $133.688mm, $136.361mm, $139.089mm. Year-1 amortization with all three buildings commenced sums to about $293.7mm (our arithmetic).

items.label: Trustee / collateral agent
items.text: Wilmington Trust, National Association.

items.label: Governing law
items.text: New York law; exclusive jurisdiction of New York State and federal courts in Manhattan.

items.label: Denominations
items.text: $2,000 minimum and $1,000 multiples (indenture refers to $2,000 minimum for partial purchases and redemptions).

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: CUSIP 982911AA7 and ISIN US982911AA70 (144A) as reported in a fund SEC N-PORT holding, with matching coupon and maturity; the identifiers do not appear in the indenture text itself. Reg S identifiers not found.

items.label: Obligor and guarantors
items.text: WULF Compute LLC is the issuer. Full and unconditional guarantees from its subsidiaries La Lupa Data LLC, Akela Data Holdings LLC and Akela Data LLC. The notes are structurally subordinated to non-guarantor subsidiaries of the issuer.

items.label: Ownership chain
items.text: TeraWulf Inc. (Nasdaq: WULF) > TeraWulf Brookings LLC > WULF Compute LLC > La Lupa Data (CB-2, Core42) and Akela Data Holdings / Akela Data LLC (CB-3, CB-4, CB-5, Fluidstack leases). Akela Data LLC is lessor under the Fluidstack leases.

items.label: Completion support
items.text: TeraWulf provides completion guarantees: it must fund WULF Compute as needed to complete the data-center buildings if notes proceeds and available funds (including prior equity contributions) are insufficient. Described as customary; no cap disclosed.

items.label: Ring-fencing
items.text: Indenture limits debt, liens, restricted payments, affiliate transactions and asset sales; project accounts and a Fluidstack lockbox control rent flows (indenture Section 4.23).

items.label: Sponsor
items.text: TeraWulf Inc., developer and owner of Lake Mariner (Barker, NY). Company states about $3.0bn of cash and restricted cash at 30-Jun-2026.

items.label: Other parent financings and commitments
items.text: $500mm 364-day delayed-draw bridge for the Justified (Hawesville, KY) campus ($100mm drawn at 30-Jun-2026); revolving credit facility and 2031 convertible notes disclosed; common stock offering closed 16-Apr-2026; Abernathy JV stake sold for about $530mm (see FLASHC dossier).

items.label: Google equity link
items.text: Google holds warrants over 73,580,000 TeraWulf shares at $0.01 strike in exchange for the Fluidstack backstop; TeraWulf said (Aug 2025) Google's pro forma stake rises to about 14%.

items.label: Competing capital needs
items.text: Parent is funding Hawesville (401MW Anthropic lease), Muskie (up to 1GW Kentucky Power service) and Chesapeake; completion guarantee relies on parent liquidity.

items.label: Fluidstack tenant entity
items.text: Fluidstack USA I Inc. leases CB-3, CB-4 and CB-5 from Akela Data LLC. Fluidstack is private and unrated; the indenture refers to its colocation customer as the Downstream Customer.

items.label: Fluidstack lease term
items.text: Initial 10-year term from each building's commencement (rent begins on the completion date), plus two 5-year renewal options.

items.label: Contracted capacity by building
items.text: CB-3 42MW, CB-4 168MW, CB-5 168MW critical IT = 378MW (company investor presentation). Aug-2025 releases cited about 360MW; the 10-Q says July 2026 amendments raised aggregate contracted load under two leases from 162MW to 168MW and moved to data-hall-by-data-hall commencement. Seed shows 366MW; company figure is 378MW (discrepancy).

items.label: Commencement status
items.text: 10-Q: one Fluidstack lease partially commenced at 30-Jun-2026; the rest expected in 2H26 and early 2027. CB-3 delivered early July 2026.

items.label: Rent economics
items.text: No rent per MW disclosed in documents reviewed. TeraWulf said tenant scope changes bring additional base rent per kW with annual escalation. Seed assumption of $1.59mm/MW/yr and 3.0% escalator not verified. Aug-2025 release cited $6.7bn contracted revenue (up to $16bn with extensions) for the contracted capacity headline.

items.label: Lease type
items.text: Seed says Modified Gross. Filings show leases combine space with power delivery, security and maintenance non-lease components; formal label not confirmed for Lake Mariner.

items.label: Core42 lease
items.text: 60MW critical IT; four Core42 leases all commenced by 30-Jun-2026 (two Jul/Aug 2025, two in 1H26); 10-year initial term with two 5-year renewals. Core42 is not covered by the Google backstop described in filings.

items.label: Delay and termination rights
items.text: If completion of an Akela project is delayed more than 180 days (300 days for force majeure), Fluidstack may terminate that building's lease; this termination would not trigger the Google backstop.

items.label: Location
items.text: Lake Mariner Data Campus, Barker, New York. Ground leases (Somerset-Brookings Leases plus Second A&R Lease) cover 162.7 acres in aggregate.

items.label: Capacity
items.text: Contracted at Lake Mariner: 438MW critical IT (Core42 60MW + Fluidstack 378MW) with 162MW more in pipeline; 102MW energized and generating lease revenue as of July 2026 (81MW at 30-Jun-2026).

items.label: Building sequence
items.text: CB-3 (42MW) delivered; CB-4 (168MW) first data hall in commissioning with phased delivery 2H26; CB-5 (168MW) phased delivery early 2027 (company deck: 1Q27).

items.label: Cost per MW
items.text: Company cost guidance $8-10mm per critical IT MW. Seed estimates $3,222mm facility cost and $8.8mm/MW (not verified).

items.label: Design
items.text: Buildings purpose-built for high-density liquid-cooled workloads; target design PUE 1.25.

items.label: Power supply
items.text: Grid-connected with dual 345kV transmission lines (company description). Utility agreement terms, NYISO approvals and energization steps beyond the Fluidstack commencement dates were not found in documents reviewed.

items.label: Expansion power
items.text: TeraWulf pursues 250MW of incremental power at Lake Mariner subject to interconnection approval; not part of these notes.

items.label: New York regulatory risk
items.text: July 2026 New York Executive Order No. 62 temporarily pauses certain discretionary permits for covered data-center projects. TeraWulf says it does not expect a material effect on its Cayuga site timeline; Lake Mariner was not addressed in that disclosure.

items.label: Contractor
items.text: EPC contractor and contract type (GMP vs fixed price) not identified in documents reviewed.

items.label: Schedule vs original
items.text: Aug-2025: CB-3/CB-4 to be delivered in two phases in 2026 and CB-5 operations expected 2H26. By Aug-2026: CB-4 phased through 2H26; CB-5 moved to early 2027 (1Q27).

items.label: Status at 16-Oct-2026
items.text: Last official update (5-Aug-2026): CB-3 delivered, CB-4 first hall in commissioning, 336MW (CB-4 + CB-5) under construction, company says within cost and schedule guidance. No later filing with delivery data found.

items.label: Capex secured
items.text: Company deck states about 90% of WULF Compute construction capex is secured under orders (slide text extraction; approximate).

items.label: Cost overrun protection
items.text: TeraWulf completion guarantee; construction-period DSRA ($447mm at issue, then $265mm plus next two interest payments).

items.label: Debt
items.text: $3,200mm notes at issuer level, supported by Fluidstack lockbox and Google backstop. Seed leverage 5.4x at issuance, 2.7x at maturity and 74% debt-funded are Barclays figures, not verified.

items.label: Debt service reserve
items.text: Required amount $447mm at the issue date; during construction $265mm plus interest due on the next two payment dates (less interest paid, as defined).

items.label: Additional debt
items.text: After commencement of all datacenter leases, credit facilities limited to 50% of trailing net operating income; pari passu or Google-supported debt only up to the amount of notes redeemed or purchased through ECF offers, with maturity and call-premium constraints.

items.label: Refinancing profile
items.text: Notes mature Oct 2030 with amortization sized by building schedules; Fluidstack leases run 10 years from commencement so a balloon remains at 2030. Company materials describe refinancing into long-dated bullet debt at about 4.5x stabilized leverage.

items.label: Google backstop
items.text: Under recognition agreements with Fluidstack and Google LLC, on a Fluidstack payment default or insolvency Google may either pay the lease termination fee or pay current rent and assume the lease. Backstop becomes effective at each lease's commencement date.

items.label: Size
items.text: About $3.2bn total after CB-5 (initial CB-3/CB-4 plus $1.4bn incremental). Company says $600mm of Google credit support became effective when CB-3 was delivered in July 2026; the remainder follows later commencements (implied by the commencement-based mechanism).

items.label: Construction-period bridge
items.text: Google pledged its warrants to the collateral agent; the pledge releases at the earlier of each lease commencement or notes repayment. A Google affiliate also agreed with the collateral agent to cause Google to pay the Termination Fee per the recognition agreements.

items.label: Warrants
items.text: 73,580,000 TeraWulf warrants at $0.01; exercisable from the earlier of lease commencement or 180 days after target commencement; expiry 13-Aug-2030 (41,011,803) and 17-Aug-2030 (32,568,197). Company booked a $515.5mm deferred asset for their fair value.

items.label: Limits
items.text: Backstop triggers only on payment default or insolvency; delay terminations and other termination events do not trigger it.

items.label: Alphabet disclosure
items.text: Alphabet 10-Q shows credit derivatives for data-center backstops with $43,785mm gross notional at 30-Jun-2026 (vs $16,940mm at 31-Dec-2025) and $815mm fair-value liability; terms up to 15 years; Google retains the right to assume leases. Counterparties are not named.

items.label: Negative covenants
items.text: Limits on additional debt, restricted payments, investments, liens, asset sales, affiliate transactions and mergers; 101% change-of-control offer; customary events of default.

items.label: Excess cash flow
items.text: 50% ECF offer to holders at par each semiannual payment date, per 10-Q after completion of the initial phase.

items.label: Cash waterfall
items.text: Indenture Section 4.23 sets project accounts and Fluidstack lockbox arrangements; full priority of payments not reproduced here.

items.label: DSCR / lock-up
items.text: Text searches of the indenture for DSCR, debt service coverage or lock-up tests returned no hits; no financial maintenance covenant identified.

items.label: Ratings
items.text: Seed shows Ba2 / BB / BB (Moody's/S&P/Fitch). No agency release was accessible; ratings, outlooks, dates and triggers are unverified.

items.label: Use
items.text: Net proceeds finance a portion of the Lake Mariner data-center expansion in Barker, New York (CB-3, CB-4, CB-5).

items.label: Delivery delay
items.text: CB-5 slipped from 2H26 to early 2027; slippage beyond 180 days permits Fluidstack termination without Google backstop coverage.

items.label: Backstop timing
items.text: Google backstop is only effective after each building commences; until then protection is pledged warrants and the completion guarantee.

items.label: Parent liquidity
items.text: Completion guarantee depends on TeraWulf, which is committing capital to Hawesville, Muskie and Chesapeake.

items.label: Tenant concentration
items.text: All Fluidstack buildings depend on one private, unrated tenant (Google-backstopped); Core42 (60MW) has no Google support.

items.label: Regulatory
items.text: New York EO 62 pause on discretionary permits could affect expansion; effect on Lake Mariner completion not disclosed.

items.label: Refinancing
items.text: 2030 maturity precedes lease expiry; ECF offers and amortization reduce but do not eliminate the balloon.

items.label: CB-3 delivered
items.text: Early July 2026: CB-3 delivered, taking revenue-generating capacity to 102MW and making $600mm of Google credit support effective.

items.label: Lease amendments
items.text: July 2026: Fluidstack leases amended (162MW to 168MW under two leases; data-hall commencement).

items.label: Q2 2026 results
items.text: 5-Aug-2026: HPC lease revenue $31.9mm (71% of revenue); CB-4/CB-5 within company cost and schedule guidance.

items.label: Parent actions
items.text: July 2026: Anthropic 401MW lease at Hawesville and sale of Abernathy JV stake for about $530mm; 5-Oct-2026 Muskie expansion release.

timeline.text: Core42 HPC leases signed at Lake Mariner (changed Aug 2025).
Fluidstack Leases (CB-3/CB-4) signed; Google recognition agreements and warrants over 41.0mm shares.
CB-5 lease (160MW); Google backstop increased to about $3.2bn; Google pro forma stake about 14%.
Offering risk factors furnished ahead of notes marketing.
WULF Compute prices $3.2bn 7.750% notes due 2030 at par.
Notes close; indenture signed with Wilmington Trust.
TeraWulf common stock offering closes (underwriting agreement 14-Apr-2026).
CB-3 delivered (early July); $600mm Google credit support becomes effective; revenue-generating capacity 102MW.
New York Executive Order No. 62 pauses certain data-center permits.
Anthropic 401MW lease at Hawesville announced; Abernathy stake sale (~$530mm).
Q2 results and 10-Q: CB-4 first hall in commissioning; CB-5 targeted early 2027.
TeraWulf Muskie power-expansion 8-K (no WULF Compute disclosure).

YNDRDC.title: Yondr JK 1, LLC 6 7/8% Senior Secured Notes due 30-Jun-2031 (Yondr Group / JK Land Holdings, Loudoun County, VA)
YNDRDC.headline: $715mm 6.875% senior secured notes due June 2031, issued in late June 2026 by a Yondr Group/JK Land Holdings JV to partly fund a 48MW turnkey data center on about 14.3 acres in Loudoun County, Virginia. Public documents confirm the notes, security (first liens plus HoldCo equity pledge) and use of proceeds, but not the tenant, lease or ratings; the Oracle tenancy and Ba3/BB ratings are seed-only. The spread over Oracle's 2031 notes reflects single-asset, short-tenor, high-balloon risk, unverified lease terms and Loudoun zoning/grandfathering uncertainty; on 6-Oct-2026 the Board tabled any repeal of grandfathering.

items.label: Issuer
items.text: Yondr JK 1, LLC, described by Yondr/JK Land as their joint venture (Milbank calls it a Yondr Group subsidiary).

items.label: Notes title and size
items.text: $715,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 6.875% senior secured notes due 2031.

items.label: Coupon and payment dates
items.text: 6.875% per year, paid semi-annually in cash in arrears on 30-Jun and 30-Dec; first payment 30-Dec-2026.

items.label: Pricing and issue date
items.text: Priced 24-Jun-2026; delivery via DTC expected on or about 30-Jun-2026 (seed issue date 30-Jun-2026 consistent). Offer price/yield not disclosed in the release.

items.label: Offering format
items.text: Rule 144A to QIBs and Regulation S to non-US persons; not registered under the Securities Act.

items.label: Security package
items.text: First-priority liens on substantially all of the issuer's assets (excluding certain excluded property) and on all equity interests in the issuer held by Yondr JK 1 HoldCo, LLC (Delaware), which becomes the direct parent at issuance.

items.label: Amortization
items.text: Semi-annual amortization payments begin after the final commencement date; schedule is in the offering memorandum (not accessible). Seed: starts late 2028, about 8.8% amortized to maturity (leverage 8.9x to 7.3x at maturity).

items.label: Call schedule
items.text: Seed: first call 30-Jun-2028 at 103.44. Not confirmed; make-whole terms unknown.

items.label: ISIN / CUSIP
items.text: US985925AA44 / 985925AA4 per seed (144A). Not confirmed in any document read.

items.label: Initial purchasers' counsel and issuer counsel
items.text: Cahill Gordon & Reindel represented the initial purchasers; Milbank LLP advised Yondr. Trustee, governing law and denominations not found.

items.label: Borrower chain
items.text: Yondr JK 1 HoldCo, LLC (Delaware) is the direct parent of Yondr JK 1, LLC (issuer); Yondr Group and JK Land Holdings are the JV partners. Ownership split not disclosed.

items.label: Ring-fencing
items.text: Single-asset SPV; notes secured by first liens on all issuer assets and the HoldCo pledge of issuer equity. Further ring-fencing terms not available.

items.label: Structure in words
items.text: JV HoldCo owns the issuer, which owns the 48MW building on a roughly 14.3-acre Loudoun County site; the notes are the issuer's senior secured debt.

items.label: Yondr Group
items.text: Hyperscale data center developer, owner and operator headquartered in London; DigitalBridge and La Caisse completed their acquisition of Yondr on 1-Jul-2025.

items.label: JK Land Holdings
items.text: Sterling (Loudoun County), Virginia based real estate company; per press and local reporting it owns land at the Arcola technology park.

items.label: Yondr Arcola presence
items.text: Yondr already operates an Arcola, VA campus (Project 'Allegro South', first phase operational 2024; second building started Feb-2024) and lists an adjacent-parcel expansion; financing is not confirmed to cover that expansion parcel.

items.label: Other financings
items.text: Not found in documents read.

items.label: Tenant
items.text: Oracle per the user brief and seed. The issuer press release, law-firm notices and press coverage do not name the tenant or offtaker; Oracle's filings do not name Yondr.

items.label: Lease type and term
items.text: Seed: modified gross, 15 years with two 5-year extensions. Not verified.

items.label: Rent
items.text: Seed: about $1.95mm per MW per year with 3.0% escalator. Not verified.

items.label: Commencement
items.text: Seed: lease commencement Jan 2028 to Oct 2028; the release refers to a 'final commencement date' that starts amortization, consistent with staged commencement.

items.label: Tenant credit context
items.text: Oracle's own 4.95% notes due 4-Feb-2031 were priced at 99.834 to yield 4.988% (T+115) in Feb-2026; Oracle reports $288bn of not-yet-commenced data center leases at 31-Aug-2026.

items.label: Location
items.text: Loudoun County, Virginia (Arcola area per Yondr's existing campus; seed site name 'Allegro North'). The name 'Allegro North' was not found in any document.

items.label: Capacity
items.text: 48 MW of critical IT capacity, a turnkey data center.

items.label: Site
items.text: Roughly 14.3 acres.

items.label: Cost
items.text: Seed: facility cost $738mm ($15.4mm per MW); notes $715mm. Not verified.

items.label: What the notes finance
items.text: Part of construction of the data center, debt service reserves, and offering fees and expenses.

items.label: Utility and interconnection
items.text: No power, substation or Dominion interconnection details found for this parcel.

items.label: Entitlements
items.text: Local reporting says Yondr broke ground on a new 48MW building at Arcola; the by-right/grandfathered status of this specific site plan was not confirmed (see risks).

items.label: Start
items.text: Seed: construction start Feb 2026. The release says proceeds partly fund construction, so the project was under construction or about to start at pricing.

items.label: Contractor and contract type
items.text: Not disclosed.

items.label: Completion
items.text: No official completion timeline published; seed implies lease commencement Jan-Oct 2028.

items.label: Debt
items.text: $715mm senior secured notes; equity contribution from the JV partners not disclosed. Seed: 82% debt-funded, 8.9x leverage at issuance, 7.3x at maturity.

items.label: Reserves
items.text: Proceeds fund debt service reserves (sizes not disclosed).

items.label: Refinancing risk
items.text: Notes mature June 2031 with only partial amortization per seed (about 8.8%), implying a large balloon (about 91%, derived from seed) dependent on refinancing or lease renewal.

items.label: Guarantees
items.text: No parent or tenant guaranty disclosed in documents read. Credit support, completion guaranty and termination payments unknown.

items.label: Covenants
items.text: Not available (offering memorandum private).

items.label: Ratings
items.text: Seed: Moody's Ba3, Fitch BB (S&P NR). No rating agency release found; no agency publication read.

items.label: Use
items.text: Finance part of construction of the 48MW data center, fund debt service reserves, pay fees and expenses of the offering.

items.label: Loudoun grandfathering
items.text: Loudoun ended by-right data center approvals in Mar-2025 but passed a grandfathering resolution for site plans accepted by 12-Feb-2025 (protection to Feb-2028, lost if developers stop pursuing or substantially change plans). Staff warned that ending grandfathering could cost the county $45mm-$60mm in litigation. Whether this project is among the 15 grandfathered projects is unconfirmed.

items.label: Single tenant, single asset, short tenor
items.text: One 48MW asset, tenant not publicly named, a 5-year bullet-like maturity with high refinancing share.

items.label: Construction and power
items.text: No contractor, power or interconnection information found; delivery by 2028 not verifiable.

items.label: 6-Oct-2026 Board action
items.text: Loudoun Board of Supervisors tabled the whole item: ending grandfathering, the data center approval proposal and the $200,000 outside audit of 15 grandfathered projects (30 buildings, about 10.5M sq ft). Chair Phyllis Randall moved to table; one report says a majority agreed, another summary reports 7-2. Grandfathering therefore stays in place; item deferred to an unspecified later date.

items.label: Audit proposal
